Rights advocates say the crackdown has violated due process and free speech rights and has created an unsafe environment, particularly for ethnic minorities, who have raised concerns about [USN:L4N3ZU0AN TEXT:"racial profiling"]. The State Department said on Tuesday the Trump administration has [USN:L1N46613L TEXT:"revoked over 300,000 US visas"] during his second term. Among visa revocations particularly condemned by rights advocates are those of pro-Palestinian protesters demonstrating against US ally [USN:L6N42U0SO TEXT:"Israel's assault on Gaza"] and of foreigners over [USN:L2N3VV14E TEXT:"social media comments"] about conservative commentator Charlie Kirk's assassination. The Trump administration's deportation attempts have faced multiple legal challenges with mixed results.

item.title: Venezuelanos se manifestam em todo o país para exigir eleições, no maior protesto contra o governo dos últimos anos
item.description: Milhares de venezuelanos saíram às ruas nesta quinta-feira, no primeiro protesto da oposição em nível nacional em quase dois anos, exigindo eleições livres e outras mudanças políticas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Milhares de venezuelanos saíram às ruas nesta quinta-feira, no primeiro protesto da oposição em nível nacional em quase dois anos, exigindo eleições livres e outras mudanças políticas. Os Estados Unidos têm trabalhado em estreita colaboração com o governo interino liderado pela presidente interina, Delcy Rodríguez, desde que suas forças capturaram Nicolás Maduro em janeiro. Tanto o presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, quanto Delcy Rodríguez afirmaram que haverá eleições, mas ainda não definiram uma data nem para as eleições legislativas nem para o processo presidencial. A líder da oposição e ganhadora do Prêmio Nobel da Paz, María Corina Machado, destacou que as eleições devem ocorrer antes de julho de 2027. Seu movimento, Vente Venezuela, organizou o protesto, que ocorreu em Caracas e se repetiu em cidades como Valência, Maracay, San Cristóbal e Maracaibo. “Vejo isso e fico feliz porque sei que é possível alcançar a mudança”, disse Leosmary Hernández, uma estudante de cosmetologia de 18 anos em Maracay, no Estado central de Aragua. Nos últimos anos, “passei por tantas coisas ruins, tantos problemas com o dólar, dificuldades para estudar. Tenho grandes expectativas para o meu país, pela nossa próxima governadora, a presidente María Corina”, acrescentou. O movimento socialista venezuelano — no poder desde 1999, primeiro sob o mandato de Hugo Chávez e, posteriormente, de Maduro — já recorreu, no passado, ao envio de forças de segurança contra manifestantes que denunciavam a repressão política, a inflação galopante e a deterioração dos serviços públicos, entre outros problemas. O governista Partido Socialista convocou seus simpatizantes a marchar da central Plaza Venezuela, em Caracas, até um ponto próximo ao palácio presidencial, com o objetivo de comemorar o mês da conscientização sobre o câncer de mama. O ministro do Interior, Diosdado Cabello, conhecido por seus laços estreitos com os serviços de segurança, apareceu na TV estatal participando da marcha. Os simpatizantes da oposição transferiram seu protesto para um local próximo. As negociações apoiadas pelos Estados Unidos entre uma facção da oposição e o governo interino, que buscam reestruturar a Suprema Corte de Justiça e o Conselho Nacional Eleitoral com o objetivo de garantir a equidade em futuras eleições, realizaram sua última sessão neste mês. No entanto, as mudanças podem levar bastante tempo. As negociações não incluem o movimento político de Machado, que afirmou que não impedirá seu andamento. Os manifestantes também exigiram a libertação de pessoas que, segundo afirmam, permanecem detidas por motivos políticos. A organização de direitos legais Foro Penal, que representa figuras da oposição e outros detidos — muitas vezes sob acusações como a de traição à pátria —, afirma que na Venezuela ainda há mais de 320 presos políticos, apesar das libertações ocorridas este ano no âmbito de uma lei de anistia apoiada pelo Poder Legislativo. O governo negou repetidamente que mantenha presos políticos e sustenta que a anistia é generosa.

item.title: Brazil's Bradesco meets profit estimates despite slower credit revenue
item.description: Brazilian lender Banco Bradesco on Thursday reported a 14.6% increase in its third-quarter recurring net profit from a year earlier, meeting analysts' expectations despite softer growth in credit-related revenue.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazilian lender Banco Bradesco (BBDC3.SA) on Thursday reported a 14.6% increase in its third-quarter recurring net profit from a year earlier, meeting analysts' expectations despite softer growth in credit-related revenue. Bradesco, which kicked off earnings season for large Brazilian lenders, posted a 7.11 billion reais ($1.41 billion) recurring net profit for the July-September quarter, compared with the 7.14 billion reais expected in a LSEG poll of analysts. CEO Marcelo Noronha said in a statement that Bradesco kept a cautious stance and a moderate appetite for risk amid a challenging macroeconomic environment in Brazil "We saw slower growth in our credit-related revenues, but this was offset by non-credit revenues and solid cost control," he wrote Return on average equity (ROAE) rose to 15.6% from 14.7% a year earlier; Bradesco said that, excluding its recent 10 billion-real capital increase, the ROAE would land at 16.1% The loan book grew 11.1% to 1.15 trillion reais, while the over-90-day delinquency ratio edged up to 4.6% from 4.1% Provisions for loan losses reached 10.6 billion reais, rising 24.3% year-over-year The lender kept its 2026 projections unchanged Bradesco also renewed its share buyback program, with the new program set to start in November spanning up to 106.6 million shares ($1 = 5.0428 reais)

item.title: The whimsical world of 'Wildwood' comes to life in Laika's most ambitious stop-motion film
item.description: What began as a visit to a forest on the outskirts of Portland blossomed into the magical world of the stop-motion film "Wildwood," Laika Studios' most ambitious project to date.
item.dc:creator: Danielle Broadway
item.content:encoded: What began as a visit to a forest on the outskirts of Portland blossomed into the magical world of the stop-motion film "Wildwood," Laika Studios' most ambitious project to date. "The beginning was this germ of an idea," said Colin Meloy, author of the 2011 novel of the same name on which the film is based. Meloy imagined Forest Park, a 5,200-acre wooded grassland in Portland, Oregon, as a "magical kingdom" surrounded by an impervious barrier. The idea led Meloy and his wife, Carson Ellis, who illustrated the novel, to map out the park's boundaries and populate it with mystical creatures and characters, creating the foundation of their fictional world. "Wildwood," which brings the story from page to picture and arrives in theaters on Friday, follows teenager Prue McKeel, voiced by Peyton Elizabeth Lee, as she ventures into the forest outside Portland after magical crows kidnap her younger brother. The voice cast also includes Jacob Tremblay as Prue's friend Curtis, Jake Johnson as Mr. McKeel, Prue's father, and Carey Mulligan as the film's antagonist, Alexandra. "It's really once in a generation they release a movie," Johnson said, referring to Laika. "When they come out, it means something. It's really special and truly unique," he added. Laika is known for its handcrafted stop-motion films, combining traditional animation techniques with 3D printing and digital effects. Its 2009 release "Coraline" remains the studio's highest-grossing film and a Halloween cult favorite. For director Travis Knight, "Wildwood" recalled the fantasy novels he loved growing up, including the works of JRR Tolkien and CS Lewis. He said the story also had a "weird idiosyncratic voice" that felt uniquely suited to Laika, a Portland-based studio, and to him as a Portland native. Bringing the story to life in stop-motion proved a major undertaking. The production used 231 puppets, 54 central hero characters, and 136 locations. Yet animating the puppets to feel lifelike posed an even greater challenge than staging the film's large-scale battle scenes. "There's a lot of stuff that we did with the puppet department to create breathers in the puppets and muscles," said animation supervisor Brad Schiff. "So, not only can the animator control them from the outside, but they're also controlling them from the inside, which makes them feel even more alive," he added.

item.title: GM cancels deal with new US rare-earth magnet plant, documents say
item.description: General Motors , the biggest customer of a US factory making rare earth magnets for electric vehicles, cancelled its long-term supply deal with the manufacturer, and the two sides are in arbitration, according to regulatory documents and a person with knowledge of the situation.
item.dc:creator: Eric Onstad
item.content:encoded: General Motors (GM.N) , the biggest customer of a US factory making rare earth magnets for electric vehicles, cancelled its long-term supply deal with the manufacturer, and the two sides are in arbitration, according to regulatory documents and a person with knowledge of the situation. The move spotlights the challenges Western firms face in building domestic rare-earths output and cutting their reliance on China, which produces about 90% of global permanent magnets. It also shows how the US auto industry's landscape has changed since Donald Trump returned to the White House in 2025 and cut federal support for electric vehicles. Germany's Vacuumschmelze, or VAC, signed a [USN:L8N34F3IX TEXT:"long-term deal"] in 2023 with GM to supply permanent magnets for its electric vehicles from a new plant in South Carolina. Energy Fuels (UUUU.A) , which agreed in June to pay $1.9 billion to [USN:L4N42V0QM TEXT:"acquire VAC"], said in US Securities and Exchange Commission documents filed last week that a customer of the plant terminated its supply agreement on July 1, and VAC launched arbitration proceedings against that customer several days later. It did not name the customer, but GM this week reported in an SEC filing that a supplier of a component for EV traction motors "initiated an arbitration against us seeking damages after we terminated a strategic sourcing agreement," without saying why it cancelled the deal. The person familiar with the matter confirmed GM was the customer that cancelled the contract with VAC's US unit, e-VAC Magnetics. GM and Energy Fuels declined to comment on the arbitration because it is confidential. The dispute has not been previously reported and none of the companies involved have issued press releases about the issue. VAC launched its $500-million US magnet plant late last year with a capacity of just under 2,000 metric tons a year, and 90% was set to be sold to GM, with the remainder supplying the US government, VAC CEO Erik Eschen [USN:L5N3UY0MF TEXT:"told Reuters"] in September last year. VAC's US unit said it was seeking damages in arbitration due to wrongful termination. "We have no concerns about VAC’s commercial success and its ability to produce rare earth permanent magnets to customer specifications," Energy Fuels said. However, Energy Fuels told Reuters there may be "potential adjustments to our purchase price of VAC depending on the outcome of the arbitration." GM ROLLS BACK EV SALES GM has been pulling back on sales of EVs, which historically have lost money, following the Trump administration’s withdrawal of incentives and tax breaks meant to benefit the industry. In January, GM took a [USN:L6N3Y915L TEXT:"$6 billion charge"] to unwind some EV investments. When GM and VAC announced the supply deal three years ago, VAC said the plant would support GM for a minimum of 10 years and supply a wide range of models. The dispute first arose in April 2026, according to the SEC documents. Energy Fuels said it was aware of the dispute when it was negotiating the VAC acquisition. Energy Fuels, a producer of uranium for the nuclear power industry, said the takeover would allow it to become one of the world's largest non-Chinese producers of magnets used in the aerospace, defence and renewable energy sectors. VAC supplies magnets to more than 1,000 customers, from facilities in Germany, Malaysia and other countries.

item.title: Venezolanos marchan en todo el país para exigir elecciones, en mayor protesta antigubernametal en años
item.description: Miles de venezolanos salieron a las calles el jueves en la primera protesta de la oposición a nivel nacional en casi dos años, mientras los manifestantes exigían elecciones libres y otros cambios políticos con una presencia notablemente escasa de las fuerzas de seguridad.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Miles de venezolanos salieron a las calles el jueves en la primera protesta de la oposición a nivel nacional en casi dos años, mientras los manifestantes exigían elecciones libres y otros cambios políticos con una presencia notablemente escasa de las fuerzas de seguridad. Estados Unidos ha trabajado estrechamente con el gobierno interino encabezado por la presidenta encargada Delcy Rodríguez, desde que sus fuerzas capturaron en enero a Nicolás Maduro. Tanto el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, como Rodríguez han afirmado que habrá elecciones, pero aún no han fijado una fecha ni para los comicios legislativos ni para el proceso presidencial. La líder opositora y ganadora del Premio Nobel de la Paz, María Corina Machado, ha señalado que los comicios deben celebrarse antes de julio de 2027. Su movimiento Vente Venezuela organizó la protesta, que tuvo lugar en Caracas y se replicó en ciudades como Valencia, Maracay, San Cristóbal y Maracaibo. "Veo esto y me siento feliz porque yo sé que se puede lograr el cambio", dijo Leosmary Hernández, una estudiante de cosmetología de 18 años en Maracay, en el estado central de Aragua. En los últimos años "he pasado tantas cosas malas, tantos problemas con el dólar, dificultades para estudiar. Tengo unas grandes expectativas para mi país, por nuestra próxima gobernadora, presidenta María Corina", agregó. El movimiento socialista venezolano —en el poder desde 1999, primero bajo el mandato de Hugo Chávez y posteriormente de Maduro— ha recurrido en el pasado al despliegue de fuerzas de seguridad contra manifestantes que denunciaban la represión política, una inflación galopante, el deterioro de los servicios públicos, entre otros problemas. El gobernante Partido Socialista convocó a sus simpatizantes a marchar desde la céntrica Plaza Venezuela de Caracas hacia un punto cercano al palacio presidencial, con el fin de conmemorar el mes de la concienciación sobre el cáncer de mama. El ministro del Interior, Diosdado Cabello, conocido por sus estrechos vínculos con los servicios de seguridad, apareció en la TV estatal participando en la marcha. Los simpatizantes de la oposición trasladaron su protesta a un lugar cercano. Rodríguez envió un mensaje a los participantes de la manifestación a través de una llamada divulgada por la televisora estatal. Las conversaciones respaldadas por Estados Unidos entre una facción de la oposición y el gobierno interino, que buscan reestructurar el Tribunal Supremo de Justicia y el Consejo Nacional Electoral con el fin de garantizar la equidad en futuras elecciones, celebraron su última sesión este mes. Sin embargo, los cambios podrían llevar bastante tiempo. Rodríguez tenía previsto reunirse en el palacio de gobierno con Dinorah Figuera, la jefa de la delegación opositora en las conversaciones apoyadas por Washington, según imágenes de la televisora estatal mostrando la llegada de Figuera a la sede oficial. Las negociaciones no incluyen al movimiento político de Machado, quien ha manifestado que no obstaculizará su avance. "Queremos elecciones presidenciales ya, que se haga un cronograma ya. No vamos a esperar hasta 2028", dijo María Débora Marín, de 57 años, quien regenta una tienda de ropa en el centro de la ciudad de Valencia, a unos 150 kilómetros al sur de Caracas, al referirse a versiones de que las elecciones podrían celebrarse recién dentro de dos años. "Lo que queremos es avanzar, salir ya de esta pesadilla", agregó. En estos momentos "estamos en un limbo", comentó Rayeska Puesme, de 18 años y recién graduada, mientras participaba en la protesta en Caracas, añadiendo que ha considerado marcharse de Venezuela debido a la falta de oportunidades. "Estados Unidos saco un gran problema, que fue Maduro, pero falta el resto", añadió. "Siento en mi corazón que las cosas van a cambiar, pero no veo cuándo", dijo. Los manifestantes también exigieron la liberación de personas que, según afirman, permanecen detenidas por motivos políticos. La organización de derechos legales Foro Penal, que representa a figuras de la oposición y a otros detenidos —a menudo bajo cargos como el de traición a la patria-, afirma que en Venezuela todavía hay más de 320 presos políticos, a pesar de las liberaciones que tuvieron lugar este año en el marco de una ley de amnistía respaldada por el poder legislativo. El gobierno ha negado reiteradamente que mantenga a presos políticos y sostiene que la amnistía es generosa.

item.title: Tesouro dos EUA retira Venezuela da lista de países sujeitos a restrições aos investimentos dos EUA no exterior
item.description: O Departamento do Tesouro dos EUA anunciou nesta quinta-feira uma proposta de regulamentação para a análise de investimentos no exterior na China, na Rússia e em outros países — uma lista que não inclui mais a Venezuela, agora que o ex-presidente do país Nicolás Maduro não está mais no poder.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Shalal
item.content:encoded: O Departamento do Tesouro dos EUA anunciou nesta quinta-feira uma proposta de regulamentação para a análise de investimentos no exterior na China, na Rússia e em outros países — uma lista que não inclui mais a Venezuela, agora que o ex-presidente do país Nicolás Maduro não está mais no poder. O Tesouro aceitará comentários até 7 de dezembro sobre as regras propostas, que foram determinadas pela Lei Abrangente de Segurança Nacional para Investimentos no Exterior de 2025 (COINS Act), aprovada pelo Congresso em dezembro, mas que surgiu de um esforço bipartidário iniciado pelo ex-presidente Joe Biden em 2023. A Lei COINS marcou uma expansão significativa dos controles sobre os investimentos externos dos EUA, exigindo que empresas e indivíduos norte-americanos notifiquem o Tesouro sobre certos planos de investimento, ao mesmo tempo em que os proíbe totalmente em outros casos para evitar danos à segurança nacional dos EUA. Ela ampliou a lista de países abrangidos e incluiu a biotecnologia como um dos setores restritos, conferindo ao Tesouro a autoridade para adicionar outros setores conforme necessário. O programa de investimentos no exterior tinha inicialmente como alvo apenas a China, mas a legislação COINS ampliou a lista de países “motivos de preocupação” para incluir Cuba, Irã, Coreia do Norte, Rússia e Venezuela “sob o regime de Nicolás Maduro”. Mas o Tesouro afirmou que retirou a Venezuela da lista, uma vez que o governo Maduro “não existe mais” após a captura do ex-presidente por forças norte-americanas em janeiro, acrescentando que o atual governo, liderado pela vice de Maduro, Delcy Rodríguez, não se enquadrava na definição. A regra proposta ainda poderia se aplicar a certos investimentos em entidades venezuelanas, afirmou o Tesouro, sem dar mais detalhes. O presidente Donald Trump recebeu o presidente chinês Xi Jinping para uma luxuosa visita de Estado a Washington no mês passado e tem adotado uma abordagem menos restritiva em relação às tecnologias chinesas em seu segundo mandato, mas a divulgação, nesta quinta-feira, das regras propostas pode sinalizar um desejo de manter alguma pressão sobre as ambições tecnológicas de Pequim. “A ideia por trás do programa de investimentos no exterior é garantir que tenhamos a capacidade de monitorar e, potencialmente, proibir os tipos de investimentos” que representam riscos à segurança nacional dos EUA, disse à Reuters o secretário-adjunto do Tesouro, Chris Pilkerton, responsável por questões de segurança de investimentos. “Não se trata apenas do investimento em si; não se trata apenas do dinheiro. Trata-se da rede, da cadeia de suprimentos e de aspectos como esses que decorrem desse investimento”, disse ele, acrescentando que uma teia tão complexa de relações seria difícil de regulamentar de outra forma, por meio de controles de exportação ou outras medidas. O Tesouro afirmou que as regras propostas não proibiriam todos os investimentos em países que suscitam preocupação. Em vez disso, elas visariam investimentos específicos em entidades envolvidas em tecnologias de dupla utilização que beneficiem programas militares, Estados de vigilância e países com violações dos direitos humanos. As regras propostas exigem notificação sobre investimentos potenciais em seis setores e cinco países designados, ao mesmo tempo em que os proíbem totalmente no caso da inteligência artificial.

item.title: Banco brasileño Bradesco registra un beneficio recurrente en línea con previsiones en tercer trimestre
item.description: El brasileño Banco Bradesco comunicó el jueves un beneficio neto recurrente de 7.110 millones de reales (1.410 millones de dólares) en el tercer trimestre, lo que supone un aumento del 14,6% respecto al mismo periodo del año anterior.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El brasileño Banco Bradesco (BBDC3.SA) comunicó el jueves un beneficio neto recurrente de 7.110 millones de reales (1.410 millones de dólares) en el tercer trimestre, lo que supone un aumento del 14,6% respecto al mismo periodo del año anterior. El resultado, además, se ajusta aproximadamente a los 7.140 millones de reales previstos en una encuesta de LSEG realizada entre analistas. (1 dólar = 5,0428 reales)

item.title: Britain to use military aircraft to fight climate change-fuelled wildfires
item.description: Britain said on Thursday it would for the first time use military helicopters and aircraft to fight wildfires after its hottest summer on record, as the government steps up efforts to combat a threat it says is being fuelled by climate change.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain said on Thursday it would for the first time use military helicopters and aircraft to fight wildfires after its hottest summer on record, as the government steps up efforts to combat a threat it says is being fuelled by climate change. The Royal Air Force's Chinook helicopters and A400M transport aircraft to be equipped with wildfire firefighting capability. The military aircraft are to be available to support emergency services battling blazes in remote areas. Government to provide up to £45 million ($60.15 million) for specialist response teams and firefighter equipment. Government to invest £25 million in peatland restoration and support farmers to reduce wildfire risk. New AI unit to be established to help predict and track wildfires. Government to work with the Met Office, Britain's national meteorological service, to improve wildfire forecasting and risk assessment. ($1 = 0.7482 pounds)

item.title: Samarco eleva produção em 4% no 3º tri e atinge maior nível desde retomada
item.description: A mineradora Samarco, joint venture da Vale com a BHP, produziu 4,3 milhões de toneladas de pelotas e finos de minério de ferro no terceiro trimestre, alta de 4% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025 e de 10% ante o segundo trimestre deste ano, segundo prévia operacional divulgada nesta quinta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A mineradora Samarco, joint venture da Vale com a BHP, produziu 4,3 milhões de toneladas de pelotas e finos de minério de ferro no terceiro trimestre, alta de 4% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025 e de 10% ante o segundo trimestre deste ano, segundo prévia operacional divulgada nesta quinta-feira. O volume representa o maior nível trimestral desde a retomada das operações da companhia, ao final de 2020, cerca de cinco anos após o desastre envolvendo a queda de uma barragem de rejeitos de mineração. Nos nove primeiros meses de 2026, a produção alcançou 12 milhões de toneladas, avanço de 7% na comparação anual e também o maior volume para o período desde a retomada operacional. Segundo a Samarco, o desempenho reflete a manutenção de níveis elevados de produção ao longo do ano. As vendas de pelotas e finos somaram 3,9 milhões de toneladas entre julho e setembro, em linha com o trimestre anterior, mas com queda de 5% na comparação anual. No acumulado de 2026, as vendas atingiram 11,0 milhões de toneladas, crescimento de 1% sobre os nove primeiros meses de 2025. O preço médio realizado de pelotas foi de US$125,1 por tonelada no período, praticamente estável em relação ao segundo trimestre e 4% superior ao registrado um ano antes. Segundo a companhia, o resultado refletiu melhores condições comerciais e a recuperação dos prêmios de pelotas ao longo do trimestre.

item.title: Your guide to open enrollment season
item.description: I sat down this week to sign up for my 2027 benefits.
item.dc:creator: Lauren Young
item.content:encoded: I sat down this week to sign up for my 2027 benefits. Ouch. My premiums will rise by 8%. Amid [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"higher inflation"], rising healthcare costs are definitely taking a bite out of budgets. While there is not much we can do about higher premiums, one area where we do have some agency is flexible spending accounts. Figuring out how much to put into your account is always tricky. For example, most of my New York-based doctors do not accept health insurance. (I pay out of pocket and submit for reimbursement.) About 4 in 10 flexible spending account holders forfeited unused funds in 2024, according to new research from the Employee Benefit Research Institute. Those who forfeited funds returned an average of $404 to their employers. If you don’t get healthcare from your employer and buy it on the open marketplace, enrollment for US plans also starts on November 1 . But higher premiums already pushed some consumers away. Affordable Care Act and other individual health insurance plan enrollment fell 18% to 20.5 million members in June, [USN:L1N4600RY TEXT:"according to health policy research firm KFF"], marking the steepest annual decline since 2015 as Americans struggle with rising health insurance costs. One other item of note: More companies are dropping coverage of weight-loss drugs from their insurance plans. The culprit? [USN:L1N44L0V0 TEXT:"Once again, it’s rising costs"]. How is all of this impacting you? If you are picking benefits, use a flexible spending account, take weight-loss drugs or buy your own coverage, tell me how you plan to shop this year via the link in my bio. READ. WATCH. LISTEN. [USN:L6N46012F TEXT:"End of an era? How the Hermes Birkin bag is losing its scarcity appeal "] Ahead of the US midterms, Gen Z investors are making portfolio changes [USN:L6N45Z0WG TEXT:"Fed sees AI boom adding to inflation headache, but others may pay for the medicine "] Can prediction markets help us understand the future? [USN:L4N45K10K TEXT:"Beauty giants target 'Ozempic face' as boom in obesity drugs opens new market"] Are higher prices the new normal? How to give your kids money for a house without things getting weird Consumers are under pressure. Here is why that’s bad for the economy GIMME CREDIT What kind of benefits are you getting from your credit cards? I’m a big fan of racking up miles on my card for airline upgrades as well as priority boarding. According to a 2026 survey by Citizens Financial Group, 44% of Gen Z and 19% of millennials reported that credit card rewards have made a significant difference for their households, whether by helping offset costs, access experiences or get more value from their cards. Here is the story of how one young consumer is using the rewards from four credit cards to get a bigger bang from his spending. Do you maximize your credit card rewards? If so, how? Let me know the scoop via the link in my bio. THE CRYPTO COUPLE What happens when love and digital portfolios merge? I recently profiled a couple who met on a Discord server, fell in love while trading crypto tips and ultimately decided to build a portfolio — as well as a family — with digital currencies. Their story interested me because study after study shows financial literacy is sexy, including this one by crypto exchange OKX , which found that 66% of Americans believe knowledge of personal finance makes someone more attractive. Digital-asset fluency carries weight, too: 55% of men and 49% of women said that understanding digital assets makes someone more desirable, the OKX survey found. What do you think? Is fiscal fitness attractive? Tell me what you think via the link in my bio.

item.title: ＡＩ外部評価機関、オープンＡＩのシステムに脆弱性特定 監視回避に悪用の恐れ
item.description:
Aditya Soni
[２２日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）の安全性を研究する非営利団体ＭＥＴＲとレッドウッド・...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ外部評価機関、オープンＡＩのシステムに脆弱性特定　監視回避に悪用の恐れ 6:25 配信

9月23日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Aditya Soni

[２２日　ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）の安全性を研究する非営利団体ＭＥＴＲとレッドウッド・リサーチは、今年実施したパイロットレビューで、 ＡＩ開発企業オープンＡＩの内部システムに複数の新たな脆弱性を発見した。その中には、エージェントが数百回に及ぶ自らの行動を監視対象から外すために利用できた可能性のあるものも含まれていた。

ＭＥＴＲとレッドウッドは２２日、この検証は７月２１日から８月１１日にかけて実施され、「組み込み型評価」と呼ばれる手法に基づき、外部の研究者らにオープンＡＩの内部インフラへの「高度なアクセス権限」が与えられたと説明した。

両団体はそれぞれ研究者１人を派遣し、オープンＡＩの内部コード、ドキュメント、および一部の技術スタッフへのアクセスを許可する体制を検証。いずれの研究者も現場で付き添いを受け、オープンＡＩから支給された「構内から持ち出し禁止」のデバイスを使用した。

研究者らは、オープンＡＩの「Ｃｏｄｅｘ」エージェントがセキュリティー上の制限を回避し、ユーザーの完全な権限で動作する潜在的な経路があることを特定した。また、監視システムについて、７月２１日時点およびそれ以前の状態を評価対象としたと説明し、評価期間中にもオープンＡＩが同システムを拡張していたと指摘した。

オープンＡＩは両団体に対し、本番環境の安全対策に影響する脆弱性は全て修正済みだと伝えた。一方、両団体は修正内容を検証していないとしている。

オープンＡＩは「今回の調査結果は、システムを拡張する過程で安全対策を強化するのに役立ち、ＭＥＴＲや他の第三者評価機関との今後の研究協力の在り方を形作る上で一助となるだろう」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず 最終更新: 10/23(金) 6:25 ロイター

item.title: Putin says talks must focus on security for Russia, Ukraine and Europe overall
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Thursday that future talks on a settlement of the war in Ukraine should focus on security guarantees for both countries and an overall framework for security throughout Europe.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Thursday that future talks on a settlement of the war in Ukraine should focus on security guarantees for both countries and an overall framework for security throughout Europe. Putin, interviewed on Russian television a day after meeting US presidential envoy Steve Witkoff, confirmed that Russia was ready to resume US-mediated talks with Ukraine next month. He restated longstanding Kremlin policy that Russia never wanted to launch a war, but had run into hostile reactions from Ukraine on key issues of concern to Moscow. Talks on a variety of matters could lead to a positive outcome, he said, but Russia remained intent on a solution ending the conflict rather than a short-lived ceasefire. "The goal of these talks will be to ensure the security of Ukraine and Russia after reaching peace agreements, in their final form, not as a result of a temporary ceasefire for some short period of time. We are ready to resume these contacts to achieve this goal," Putin said. The Russian president said Witkoff also stressed that discussions had to extend to "the architecture of European security as a whole. And I agree with that too. Well, let's see how things develop in the coming days." Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, who met Witkoff in Norway on Tuesday, said Ukraine was [USN:L1N4670ZQ TEXT:"ready for talks"] likely to take place by early next month. Ukraine, he said, supported "any proposals for a ceasefire, an end to the war, an energy ceasefire as well as humanitarian initiatives". Efforts headed by the United States to pursue talks stalled in February with the outbreak of the US-Israeli conflict with Iran. Many of the Ukraine war issues focus on territory, with Russia demanding Ukraine cede all of eastern Ukraine's Donbas region. Kyiv rejects any notion of giving up land it currently holds. In his comments, Putin said any discussion on territory in eastern Ukraine had to consider what he said was the fact that the area was "historically Russian land". And residents there, he said, had voted to be a part of Russia in referendums staged seven months after Moscow launched its invasion. "Firstly, my attitude on this matter is that this is not their territory. It’s the territory of historical Russia," he said.

item.title: Brandon Woodruff recovery leaves Brewers with tough call before Game 1
item.description: MILWAUKEE -- After almost a decade as a franchise cornerstone, Milwaukee Brewers right-hander Brandon Woodruff hopes his comeback from his latest injury leads to a spot on the club's 2026 World Series roster.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: MILWAUKEE -- After almost a decade as a franchise cornerstone, Milwaukee Brewers right-hander Brandon Woodruff hopes his comeback from his latest injury leads to a spot on the club's 2026 World Series roster. But the team's current longest-tenured player also knows that it may be beyond his control, depending on MLB postseason roster rules. Woodruff, who missed much of 2025 recovering from shoulder surgery, has not pitched since July 4 after experiencing another issue with his shoulder. Woodruff was initially scheduled for season-ending surgery, but that was canceled when he showed signs of improvement. He began a throwing program in late August and threw off a mound during each of the Brewers' first two postseason series. He threw about two dozen live pitches Tuesday to teammates. "It went as good as it could have gone," Woodruff said Thursday. "And I've probably made their decision a little bit harder, which is a good problem for them. So, I'm lucky, I'm blessed. We got a chance to win the World Series and regardless of what happens, I will be just as excited to win if I'm on the roster or not." MLB rules say that a player on a postseason roster can be replaced only if he suffers an acute, non-chronic injury or ailment. If Woodruff were to suffer another injury, the Brewers are not sure if it would be considered recurring or pre-existing, which would prevent them from replacing Woodruff on the World Series roster. Several reports indicate the Brewers have discussed the situation with MLB. "We have a decision to make," Brewers president of baseball operations Matt Arnold said Thursday. "Still going to spend some minutes talking about him and again the rest of our group there." "This is a guy that's one of the most successful, dominant big-game pitchers I've ever been around, and there are also some rule constraints that we're having to work through with the health, etc., that have to be a consideration because he hasn't pitched in a game since July 4," Arnold said. Woodruff, 33, is 55-30 with a 3.10 ERA since debuting with the Brewers in 2017. At the end of last season, he took a $10 million buyout after declining his half of a mutual option, but then accepted the Brewers' $22.025 million, one-year qualifying offer. Woodruff made six starts in March and April this season before going on the injured list with right shoulder inflammation. In his first start back on June 22, he allowed one hit over six scoreless innings with 10 strikeouts in a no-decision against the Cincinnati Reds. The Brewers won 2-1 in 10 innings. In his third start after returning, he exited after allowing three runs in 3 2/3 innings against the Arizona Diamondbacks on July 4. There was a noticeable drop in his velocity. Brewers manager Pat Murphy said that he obviously would like to have Woodruff on the roster, but he balances that desire with what gives the club the best chance to win. "Now he's got a clean bill of health according to the trainers, but if that same injury comes up again, then we can't replace him," Murphy said. "So those are the things we've got to weigh heavily. What is he going to give us? We'd love to do it. It's a great story. But we have responsibility to those 20-some guys in there and to the organization and to the city and to whoever else we're responsible to." For Woodruff, his first World Series opportunity after nine seasons is down to wait and see. "I just wanted to be an option at this point," Woodruff said. "I know what I bring to the table as a player and I'll always believe in myself. But I also realized that I haven't pitched in a game in three months or whatever it is. So, there's definitely a lot that goes into the decision. I haven't heard anything yet. I'm sure they're going to talk about it obviously through (Thursday)." --Jim Hoehn, Field Level Media

item.title: Venezuelans call for elections in first national protest in nearly two years
item.description: Thousands of Venezuelans took to the streets on Thursday in the first nationwide opposition protest in nearly two years, as demonstrators demanded free elections and other political changes with a notably thin presence of security forces.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Thousands of Venezuelans took to the streets on Thursday in the first nationwide opposition protest in nearly two years, as demonstrators demanded free elections and other political changes with a notably thin presence of security forces. The United States has been working closely with the interim government led by acting President Delcy Rodriguez since US forces captured President Nicolas Maduro in January. Both US President Donald Trump and Rodriguez, Maduro's former deputy, have said there will be elections, but have not set a date either for a legislative vote or a national contest for president. Opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize winner Maria Corina Machado, who has been outside the country for nearly a year after living in hiding following a contested 2024 election, has said elections must take place by July 2027. Her Vente Venezuela movement organized the protest, which took place in the capital Caracas and other cities, including Valencia, Maracay, San Cristobal and Maracaibo. “Seeing this makes me happy because I know change is possible," said 18-year-old cosmetology student Leosmary Hernandez, as she gathered with hundreds of others in northern Maracay. "I’ve been through so many hardships, so many problems because of the dollar, and difficulties studying. I have high hopes for my country and for our next leader, president, Maria Corina." "I went out to protest before, when things were much tougher, and I’m even less afraid today because I want my voice to be heard,” she added as music boomed around protesters waving Venezuelan flags. Venezuela's socialist movement, in power since 1999 under late President Hugo Chavez and then Maduro, has in the past [USN:KBN1DU1MZ TEXT:"deployed security forces against protesters"] decrying political repression, dizzying inflation, poor public services and other problems in the economically battered country, including after the 2024 presidential election. Security forces had minimal presence at protest sites on Thursday, and in many smaller cities demonstrators dispersed before dark. The ruling Socialist Party called for its supporters to march from Caracas' Plaza Venezuela, the same place the opposition planned to gather two hours later, to a location near the presidential palace to commemorate Breast Cancer Awareness Month. Interior Minister Diosdado Cabello, known for his close ties to the security services, was pictured on state television attending the march, while the opposition supporters moved their protest to a nearby location. NEGOTIATIONS CONTINUE US-backed talks between a faction of the opposition and the interim government, aimed at remaking the top court and the electoral council with an eye toward ensuring fairness at eventual elections, held their latest session this month, but changes could [USN:L1N45G0XU TEXT:"take significant time"]. The negotiations do not include Machado's political movement, though she has said she will not stand in the way of their progress. Machado's proxy roundly won the 2024 election according to vote tallies released by the opposition. But the government, which never released full counts, backed Maduro, as did the country's legal and electoral institutions. "We want presidential elections now. We want an electoral timetable to be announced now. We are not going to wait until 2028," said Maria Debora Marin, 57, who runs a clothing store in central Valencia, referring to rumors elections may only take place the year after next. "What we want is to move forward and finally get out of this nightmare." Amid the arrests of some of her closest collaborators, Machado went into hiding. Her last [USN:L1N3O40ZB TEXT:"public appearance in Venezuela"] was at protests to mark Maduro's third inauguration in January 2025, where she was briefly detained. Machado has for years sought US support, [USN:L4N3W51LU TEXT:"aligning with hawks"] in the Trump team who argued that Maduro — through links to drug gangs — represented a direct threat to US national security. Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, are facing [USN:L6N46017G TEXT:"drug and torture charges"] in the US. They have pleaded not guilty. But Trump has repeatedly praised Rodriguez's management and her willingness to [USN:L6N46308A TEXT:"welcome US investors"], saying last month it is too soon to consider elections. Machado's desire to return home, especially after [USN:L6N43414H TEXT:"devastating twin earthquakes"] in June, has caused [USN:L1N42Y0X4 TEXT:"friction in Washington"], with US officials asking her to delay her trip, Reuters has reported. "We're in limbo," said recent graduate Rayeska Puesme, 18, as she attended the protest in Caracas, adding she had considered leaving because of a lack of opportunities. "The United States removed one big problem, which was Maduro, but the rest are still there." "I feel in my heart that things are going to change, but I don't see when." Demonstrators were also calling for the release of prisoners they say are held for political reasons. Legal rights group Foro Penal, which represents opposition figures and others who have been detained, often on charges like treason, says there are still more than 320 political prisoners in Venezuela, despite releases that took place under an amnesty law backed by the legislature earlier this year. The government has repeatedly denied holding political prisoners and says the amnesty is generous.

item.title: Bradesco tem lucro líquido de R$7,1 bi no 3º tri, aprova recompra de ações
item.description: O Bradesco teve lucro líquido recorrente de R$7,1 bilhões no terceiro trimestre, alta de 14,6% em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado, em linha com as previsões no mercado, com o presidente-executivo do banco, Marcelo Noronha, apontando um mercado de crédito mais restrito, com a taxa de juros em nível elevado e desaceleração da economia.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: O Bradesco (BBDC3.SA) teve lucro líquido recorrente de R$7,1 bilhões no terceiro trimestre, alta de 14,6% em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado, em linha com as previsões no mercado, com o presidente-executivo do banco, Marcelo Noronha, apontando um mercado de crédito mais restrito, com a taxa de juros em nível elevado e desaceleração da economia. O banco também anunciou um novo programa de [USN:L1N4681ED TEXT:"recompra"] de ações envolvendo 3,55% das ações ordinárias e aproximadamente 1% dos papéis preferenciais em circulação. O Bradesco também afirmou que aprovou R$4,1 bilhões em juros sobre capital próprio aos acionistas no terceiro trimestre. "É cenário desafiador para todos", afirmou o executivo em comunicado à imprensa, após a divulgação do balanço nesta quinta-feira. "Vimos nossas receitas relacionadas a crédito crescerem menos, mas conseguimos compensá-las com receitas não oriundas de crédito e bom controle de despesas”, acrescentou. Na comparação trimestral, o lucro do Bradesco subiu apenas 0,8%. A carteira de crédito da instituição totalizou R$1,15 trilhão no final de setembro, aumento de 11,1% ano a ano, mas de apenas 1,1% em relação ao final de junho. O índice de inadimplência acima de 90 dias no terceiro trimestre ficou em 4,6%, de 4,1% um ano antes e 4,3% no segundo trimestre de 2026. O custo do crédito, representado pela despesa de provisões (PDD) expandida, cresceu 24,3% ano a ano e 6,6% na comparação trimestral, para R$10,6 bilhões. O banco atribuiu a "leve alta" na inadimplência acima de 90 dias no trimestre ao segmento de micro, pequenas e médias empresas (MPME), particularmente nas operações de capital de giro com garantia do Governo Federal, afirmando que os atrasos desse produto corresponderam a cerca de metade da evolução da inadimplência total. Também destacou atrasos sazonais nas operações do Banco John Deere, que pressionaram os indicadores de pessoas físicas. Na movimentação da carteira de crédito por estágios, o montante no estágio 1, considerado com risco saudável, de até 30 dias, somava R$730,8 bilhões, enquanto no estágio 2, que mostram aumento de risco, com atrasos entre 31 e 90 dias; totalizava R$46,7 bilhões e no estágio 3, que indica problemas de recuperação de crédito; alcançava R$62,5 bilhões. No segundo trimestre do ano, esses valores eram R$727,3 bilhões, R$46 bilhões e R$60,2 bilhões, respectivamente. CONTROLE DE DESPESAS No terceiro trimestre, o retorno sobre o patrimônio líquido médio (ROAE) ficou em 15,6%, de 14,7% no mesmo intervalo do ano passado e 16,2% no segundo trimestre do ano. Desconsiderando o [USN:L1N45O0VZ TEXT:"aumento de capital"] de R$10 bilhões homologado no começo de outubro, o ROAE foi de 16,1%. O aumento de capital ajudou na melhora dos índices de capital do banco. O Bradesco encerrou o terceiro trimestre com índice de Basileia total de 16% e de capital principal de 12,1%. Um ano antes esses percentuais eram 15,9% e 11,4%, respectivamente. Em junho, eram 15,5% e 11,3%. As receitas totais do banco somaram R$38 bilhões, alta de 8,4% ano a ano, com a margem financeira total somando quase R$21,4 bilhões, expansão de 14,2% na mesma base de comparação. A margem com clientes cresceu 10,1%, para 20,5 bilhões, enquanto a margem com mercado alcançou R$875 milhões, de R$99 milhões um ano antes. As despesas operacionais recuaram 1%. O índice de eficiência ficou em 45,4%, de 50,1% no mesmo período do ano passado. Ao final de setembro, o banco tinha uma rede com 1.741 agências, além de 723 unidades de negócios e 1.428 postos de atendimento. Em junho, eram 1.844 agências, além de 698 unidades de negócios e 1.565 postos de atendimento. O resultado do grupo segurador do Bradesco mostrou lucro líquido recorrente de R$2,9 bilhões, alta de 14,1% ano a ano, com ROAE de 22%.

item.title: Ator Tom Skerritt, protagonista de “Alien” e “Top Gun”, morre aos 93 anos
item.description: O versátil ator Tom Skerritt, que estrelou grandes sucessos de Hollywood, incluindo o clássico de ficção científica “Alien”, a comédia de guerra “M.A.S.H” e o drama de ação “Top Gun”, faleceu aos 93 anos, confirmou seu empresário.
item.dc:creator: Will Dunham
item.content:encoded: O versátil ator Tom Skerritt, que estrelou grandes sucessos de Hollywood, incluindo o clássico de ficção científica “Alien”, a comédia de guerra “M.A.S.H” e o drama de ação “Top Gun”, faleceu aos 93 anos, confirmou seu empresário. Natural de Detroit, Skerritt, cuja carreira em Hollywood se estendeu da década de 1960 até a década de 2020, faleceu na quarta-feira de causas naturais, informou a ABC7, citando um comunicado da família do ator. Conhecido por sua beleza rude e pela capacidade de se destacar em diversos gêneros, Skerritt desempenhou atuações memoráveis em papéis principais e coadjuvantes no cinema e na televisão. O papel que marcou a carreira de Skerritt foi o de um cirurgião rebelde do Exército dos EUA na comédia de humor negro “M.A.S.H”, de 1970, do diretor Robert Altman, sobre a Guerra da Coreia -- filme cujo elenco também contava com Donald Sutherland, Elliott Gould e Sally Kellerman. Skerritt interpretou o sulista Duke Forrest enquanto os médicos do Hospital Cirúrgico Móvel do Exército atendiam soldados feridos. O filme, cuja popularidade coincidiu com o mal-estar dos norte-americanos em relação à Guerra do Vietnã, foi indicado a cinco prêmios do Oscar. No claustrofóbico filme de ficção científica e terror “Alien”, de 1979, dirigido por Ridley Scott, Skerritt interpretou Dallas, o capitão de uma nave espacial malfadada cuja tripulação se depara com uma criatura extraterrestre parasita mortal, de aparência surrealista e atitude hostil. Em uma das cenas mais famosas e sangrentas do filme, o personagem de Skerritt está sentado ao lado de seu colega de elenco John Hurt quando um bebê alienígena sai violentamente do torso do personagem de Hurt. “Alien”, uma obra-prima influente cujo elenco também contava com Sigourney Weaver e Ian Holm, recebeu duas indicações ao Oscar. “São a espontaneidade e o impulso que fazem a diferença, e foi isso que senti que tivemos em ‘Alien’. Cada um de nós tinha essa sintonia imediata uns com os outros -- o respeito que eu tinha pelos outros atores e o respeito que eles tinham por mim”, disse Skerritt ao entrevistador Peter Sobczynski em 2019, ao mesmo tempo em que elogiava a genialidade de Scott como diretor. “Alien” foi um dos vários filmes em que Skerritt atuou e que apresentavam personagens femininas fortes, neste caso a corajosa Ripley, interpretada por Weaver. Isso foi considerado pioneiro na época. “Quando li o roteiro, uma das coisas que mais gostei foi que a mulher se torna a heroína. Adorei isso”, disse Skerritt. “Ver mulheres em posições de força e determinação para estabelecer as conexões certas e tomar as decisões corretas foi o que me atraiu. Eu também vivenciei isso em ‘Flores de Aço’, com as mulheres daquele filme. Gostei da ideia de mulheres serem duronas, fortes e influentes.” Em “Flores de Aço” (1989), Skerritt interpretou Drum Eatenton, marido de M’Lynn Eatenton, personagem de Sally Field. Tony Scott, irmão do diretor de “Alien”, escalou Skerritt para o importante papel coadjuvante do instrutor da aviação naval Viper Metcalf no sucesso de bilheteria de 1986 “Top Gun”, que ajudou o astro Tom Cruise a alçar voo rumo à estratosfera de Hollywood. Skerritt também interpretou o marido de Shirley MacLaine no drama de balé “Momento de Decisão”, de 1977, dirigido por Herbert Ross, e contracenou com outra estrela em ascensão, Brad Pitt, no drama de época “Nada É Para Sempre”, de 1992, dirigido por Robert Redford e com belíssimas imagens. Entre outros filmes em que atuou, destacam-se: “Ensina-me a Viver” (1971), “Castelos de Gelo” (1978), “Na Hora Da Zona Morta” (1983), “Poltergeist 3 - O Capítulo Final” (1988), “Contato” (1997), “Lágrimas do Sol” (2003) e “Ted” (2012). Nascido em 25 de agosto de 1933, em Detroit, Skerritt serviu na Força Aérea dos Estados Unidos antes de se tornar ator, fazendo sua estreia no cinema em 1962 ao lado de um jovem Redford em “Obsessão de Matar”. Ele era pai de cinco filhos e se casou três vezes.

item.title: Trump invokes Cold War-era Defense Production Act for oil production, refining
item.description: US President Donald Trump determined on Thursday that petroleum production, refining, and related activities are essential to national defense, a move that could open up US funding for fossil fuel projects.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump determined on Thursday that petroleum production, refining, and related activities are essential to national defense, a move that could open up US funding for fossil fuel projects. In a presidential memo, Trump also invoked part of the Cold War-era Defense Production Act, allowing him to provide financial incentives for oil-related activities, pipelines and storage of liquid fuels. Prices for crude oil and [USN:L6N45Z19G TEXT:"diesel"] have surged since the US and Israel attacked Iran in joint action at the end of February. Since then, the conflict has limited energy shipments globally, with Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries exacerbating the fuel shortages. The surge in costs poses a risk for Trump in the November 3 elections, as his fellow Republicans try to maintain control of both chambers of Congress. The Reuters/Ipsos opinion poll that closed Monday shows [USN:L6N465159 TEXT:"just 36% of Americans"] approve of Trump's handling of the economy. The memo said that without taking the actions, the US is not able to provide enough of those energy services in a "timely manner due to constrained financing, long lead times, permitting and infrastructure bottlenecks, and supply chain limitations." The memo did not mention specific projects that could be funded. The US averaged around 13.6 million barrels of daily crude production in 2025, making it the largest crude producer worldwide. Last week, Vice President [USN:L6N45Z1BU TEXT:"JD Vance said"] the administration would use the Defense Production Act to expand capacity of a Texas refinery owned by Delek US Holdings (DK.N) Trump signed legislation last year that included $1 billion in Defense Production Act funding for energy-related projects deemed critical to national security.

item.title: Steelers scrap Paris fan event as Saints game proceeds despite protests
item.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers cancelled a weekend fan event in Paris on Thursday as French authorities prepared for fresh protests ahead of the NFL's first regular-season game in the capital.
item.dc:creator: Vincent Daheron, Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: The Pittsburgh Steelers cancelled a weekend fan event in Paris on Thursday as French authorities prepared for fresh protests ahead of the NFL's first regular-season game in the capital. France experienced some of its worst urban unrest in years [USN:L8N4670KY TEXT:"last weekend"], prompting President Emmanuel Macron to tighten curbs on protests [USN:L6N4680S7 TEXT:"on Thursday"], amid fears that demonstrations planned for Saturday could turn violent. The Steelers face the New Orleans Saints at the Stade de France in Saint-Denis on Sunday, around 10 kilometres from the Place de la Bastille, where Saturday's protests are expected to begin. The Steelers informed fans on Thursday that a "Steelers House" fan event in the Bastille neighbourhood would not go forward. "The NFL, as they do for every game, including international games, is working closely with local authorities and partners on all operational and security matters. As stated by the NFL, there have been no disruptions or impacts at League sites," the team said in a statement. "As a precautionary measure, the Steelers designated bar that had been planned in Bastille – an area that has experienced recent disruptions – will not proceed." The Saints were practising this week in Versailles after arriving in France on Monday, while the Steelers were reportedly travelling to Paris on Thursday evening. "A lot of planning, a lot of extra conversations," Steelers coach Mike McCarthy told reporters on Wednesday. "Just because all the state of what surrounds the game." The French Interior Ministry was due to hold a press conference on Friday to outline security measures for the protests on Saturday. NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell told reporters on Wednesday that he had been in contact with the US Secretary of State regarding security plans. "We're continuing to make sure we have all available information, make sure the appropriate steps are being made," said Goodell. "We're guests in the country. We're going to be good guests." The Paris game is one of a record nine international contests for the NFL this season, as the league looks to capitalise on lucrative overseas markets. League officials sought to ease concerns at a two-day owners meeting in New York this week, and [USN:L6N46612U TEXT:"told reporters"] that staging the game would not divert local security forces from other duties.

item.title: Tesoro retira a Venezuela de lista de países sujetos a restricciones inversión EEUU en el extranjero
item.description: El Departamento del Tesoro anunció el jueves una propuesta de normativa para controlar las inversiones en China, Rusia y otros países, una lista en la que no aparece Venezuela ahora que el expresidente Nicolás Maduro ya no está en el poder.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Shalal
item.content:encoded: El Departamento del Tesoro anunció el jueves una propuesta de normativa para controlar las inversiones en China, Rusia y otros países, una lista en la que no aparece Venezuela ahora que el expresidente Nicolás Maduro ya no está en el poder. La Ley Integral de Seguridad Nacional en materia de Inversiones en el Extranjero de 2025 (COINS Act), aprobada por el Congreso en diciembre, supuso una ampliación significativa de los controles sobre las inversiones en el extranjero al exigir a las empresas y particulares que notifiquen al Tesoro determinados planes de inversión. Amplió la lista de países afectados e incluyó la biotecnología como uno de los sectores restringidos, otorgando al Tesoro la autoridad para añadir sectores adicionales según sea necesario. El programa de inversiones en el extranjero se centraba inicialmente solo en China, pero la legislación COINS amplió la lista de países "que suscitan preocupación" para incluir a Cuba, Irán, Corea del Norte, Rusia y Venezuela "bajo el régimen de Nicolás Maduro". Sin embargo, el Tesoro afirmó que había excluido a Venezuela debido a que el Gobierno de Maduro "ya no existe", añadiendo que el Gobierno de la presidenta encargada Delcy Rodríguez no se ajustaba a la definición. La norma propuesta podría seguir aplicándose a determinadas inversiones en entidades venezolanas, señaló el Tesoro, sin dar más detalles. El presidente Donald Trump ha adoptado un enfoque menos restrictivo respecto a las tecnologías chinas en su segundo mandato, pero la publicación el jueves de las normas propuestas podría indicar un deseo de mantener cierta presión sobre las ambiciones tecnológicas de Pekín. El Tesoro señaló que las normas propuestas no prohibirían todas las inversiones en países que suscitan preocupación. En cambio, se centrarían en inversiones específicas en entidades dedicadas a tecnologías de doble uso que beneficien a programas militares, a Estados que practican la vigilancia y a países donde se cometen abusos contra los derechos humanos. El Tesoro añadió un sector adicional —la biotecnología— a los cinco identificados en la legislación: semiconductores avanzados y microelectrónica; sistemas de inteligencia artificial; tecnologías de información cuántica; computación de alto rendimiento y supercomputación; y sistemas hipersónicos. Señaló que ciertas biotecnologías avanzadas podrían suponer un grave riesgo para la seguridad nacional, citando la proliferación de armas biológicas, el desarrollo de interfaces cerebro-ordenador y el perjuicio para la seguridad de la cadena de suministro de EEUU. Las normas no incluyen los posibles acuerdos de licencia celebrados por empresas farmacéuticas estadounidenses con China, afirmó un responsable del Tesoro, lo que satisface una exigencia clave de grandes fabricantes de medicamentos como Pfizer (PFE.N) .

item.title: Trump invoca ley de la época de la Guerra Fría para la producción y refinado de petróleo
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, determinó el jueves que la producción y el refinado de petróleo, así como las actividades relacionadas, son esenciales para la defensa nacional.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, determinó el jueves que la producción y el refinado de petróleo, así como las actividades relacionadas, son esenciales para la defensa nacional. Trump también invocó la Ley de Producción de Defensa, de la época de la Guerra Fría, que le permite ofrecer incentivos económicos para esas actividades relacionadas con el petróleo, así como para oleoductos y almacenamiento de energía.

item.title: カナダとトルコ、戦略的パートナーシップ締結 ＦＴＡ交渉開始へ
item.description:
Maria Cheng Tuvan Gumrukcu
[アンカラ ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Maria Cheng　Tuvan Gumrukcu

[アンカラ　２２日　ロイター] - カナダのカーニー首相は２２日、トルコを初めて公式訪問し、エルドアン大統領と貿易・投資、防衛・安全保障、エネルギー、社会・外交関係を柱とする新たな戦略的パートナーシップに署名した。両国は来月に自由貿易協定（ＦＴＡ）交渉を開始することでも合意。カーニー氏は「新たな世界秩序」の中でトルコとの関係を前進させる必要性に言及し、米国への依存を減らすため新たな貿易相手国の開拓を進める取り組みを続けたい考えだ。

カーニー氏はエルドアン氏との共同記者会見で「労働者や企業に新たな機会を生み出し、カナダとトルコ両国の国民に大きな安全と繁栄をもたらす、戦略的パートナーシップという新たな種をまいた。注意深く取り組み、強い意思を持って育てていけば、何世代にもわたって発展していく」と述べた。

エルドアン大統領も「長年続いてきたトルコとカナダの断絶が解消された。両国は今、新たな時代をスタートさせる」と表明。両国間の貿易額を現在の３０億ドルから、まず５０億ドル、最終的には１００億ドルへ拡大する考えを示した。ただ、時期については言及しなかった。

カナダとトルコが署名した新たな戦略的パートナーシップは、両国の企業のビジネス拡大を通して雇用や経済機会の創出を目指すもので、４本の柱で構成され、３年間の行動計画が盛り込まれている。アンカラで行われた式典で両国の閣僚がエネルギー、防衛、航空輸送分野での協力協定に署名した。エネルギー分野では、原子力、重要鉱物、液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）などの分野で協力を強化する。

カーニー氏によると、カナダとトルコの交渉担当者は来月、アンカラで自由貿易協定（ＦＴＡ）交渉の初会合を開く。このほか、カナダ輸出開発公社（ＥＤＣ）とトルコ輸出入銀行（エクシムバンク）が、第三国での事業で両国企業の協力を促進するための新たな協定に署名する。

カーニー氏は記者会見で、「断絶」や「新たな世界秩序」の中でトルコとの関係を前進させる必要性に言及。ただ、カーニー氏もエルドアン氏も米国に直接言及することはなかった。

カーニー氏は２１―２３日の日程でトルコを訪問。２３日にはイスタンブールでトルコの主要企業幹部や投資家との会合に出席する。

item.title: Trading Day: Maximum pAIn
item.description: A wave of worry around AI and tech crashed over global markets on Thursday, slamming equities and bond yields as investors sought the refuge of US Treasuries, while a spike in Brent crude oil to a five-month high and continued unrest in France also deepened the gloom.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McGeever
item.content:encoded:
A wave of worry around [USN:L6N468196 TEXT:"AI and tech"] crashed over global markets on Thursday, slamming [USN:L6N4680M6 TEXT:"equities"] and bond yields as investors sought the refuge of US Treasuries, while a spike in Brent crude [USN:L6N4671H6 TEXT:"oil "]to a five-month high and continued unrest in [USN:L6N4680QK TEXT:"France "]also deepened the gloom. In [USN:L6N46713L TEXT:"my column today"], I look at whether the US Treasury will reduce the size of 20-year bond auctions, or soon scrap them all together. Interest payments are high, Treasury wants to shorten the maturity of the debt, and the 20-year part of the curve is relatively illiquid. Absent concerted fiscal tightening, Treasury may have to tinker round the edges if it wants to lower long-term yields. This could help. Today's Key Reads [USN:L6N468080 TEXT:"Millions of hacking attempts as companies, governments rush to patch PHP flaws "] [USN:L6N468116 TEXT:"French bond pain puts euro zone's weak links on notice "] [USN:L6N45Y119 TEXT:"Investors see risk from US midterms to AI trade as data center backlash builds "] [USN:L6N4671AG TEXT:"Musk's political baggage clouds prospects for SpaceX-Tesla deal"] [USN:L6N46718F TEXT:"Surging sterling shakes off Britain's budget blues: Mike Dolan "] Today's Key Market Moves STOCKS: South Korea -3.5%, China -2%, Japan -2.5%. [USN:L6N4680I3 TEXT:"Europe "]has biggest fall in 3 weeks. Nasdaq -2.6%, biggest fall since June 5 and sheds $1 trillion of market cap. SECTORS/SHARES: Five sectors on the S&P 500 fall, six rise. Tech -3%, utilities +2%. Philadelphia Semiconductor Index -6.7%. [USN:L1N46813Q TEXT:"Moderna "]-18%, Amazon, Nvidia -4.5%. [USN:L4N4680UW TEXT:"Blackstone "]+8%, [USN:L4N46720Z TEXT:"P&G"] +5.6% FX: [USN:L1N468013 TEXT:"Japanese yen, Swiss franc"] the biggest G10 FX gainers. Norwegian crown also up strongly. Bitcoin -4%, biggest fall since June. BONDS: [USN:L6N4680QK TEXT:"French/German"] 10y spread 175 bps, widest since 2011. US yields sink as much as 20 bps across the curve. 5-year TIPS auction soft - lowest bid/cover since April last year, highest yield in three years. COMMODITIES/METALS: [USN:L6N4671H6 TEXT:"Oil "]up as much as 4%, Brent highest since May above $112. [USN:L4N46801E TEXT:"Gold "]-2%, lowest in more than two months.

Today's Talking Points: Call security Investors' AI fears ramped up on Thursday, and not just for the usual concerns around spend, revenue and valuations. On top of all that, the global scramble by companies and governments to patch critical flaws in the PHP programming language that underpins much of the internet in response to millions of hacking attempts is a reminder of how vulnerable the world is to cybersecurity breaches and AI going rogue. When governments take websites offline as an emergency precaution, you know it's serious. "I've not seen anything like this in a long, long time," Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said. The good news is these flaws appear to have been flagged by AI before any serious or lasting damage could be wrought. The iShares Cybersecurity and Tech ETF (with the appropriate ticker symbol ) rose on Thursday, bringing its year-to-date gains up to nearly 50%. Play it safe There's been a lot of talk this year that the assets investors typically turn to in periods of market turbulence - particularly US Treasuries and other sovereign bonds - have lost their safe-haven allure. They are no longer the hedge or portfolio diversifier they used to be. There is probably some truth to that, but there's life in the old dogs yet. German bund yields had their biggest drop since May last year, and the Japanese yen and Swiss franc were the two biggest climbers in global FX markets on Thursday. The move in US Treasuries was extraordinary, as yields plunged across the curve and by as much as 20 basis points. And that was despite Brent oil spiking to $112 a barrel. Granted, gold fell, but when was the last time gold truly behaved like a "safe haven"? Bearing up China's stock market fall on Thursday means the blue-chip CSI300 index is now down more than 20% from its most recent closing peak on June 22. That's a bear market. Others might argue Chinese stocks have been in a bear market for nearly two decades, since the all-time high reached in 2007. But however you slice it, investing in China has been challenging, to put it mildly. The currency is rising and is now at a four-year high, while the 10-year bond yield is hovering around its all-time low below 1.60%. But the domestic woes of debt, deflation and depressed consumption weigh heavily. Foreign investment [USN:P8N42P008 TEXT:"flows"] into China in January-September fell 4.3% year-on-year to 548.8 billion yuan ($82.2 billion), the commerce ministry said on Thursday, while outbound non-financial direct investment totaled $101 billion. Export inflows are booming, investor inflows, not so much. What could move markets tomorrow? PMIs for US, euro zone Japan, UK (October) UK retail sales (September) European Central Bank board members Piero Cipollone and Patrick Montagner speak at separate events Canada retails sales (August) US University of Michigan inflation expectations, consumer sentiment (October, final) Want to receive Trading Day in your inbox every weekday morning? Sign up for my newsletter here . Opinions expressed are those of the author. They do not reflect the views of Reuters News, which, under the Trust Principles , is committed to integrity, independence, and freedom from bias.

item.title: FCC grants Intel waiver for foreign-made robotic devices
item.description: The Federal Communications Commission said on Thursday it has granted a waiver to Intel from its ban on some foreign-made advanced robotics.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The Federal Communications Commission said on Thursday it has granted a waiver to Intel (INTC.O) from its ban on some foreign-made advanced robotics. The FCC said it would grant a one-year waiver of its rules in order to prevent "potential disruptions in the availability of domestic semiconductor manufacturing services for Intel’s customers." Intel in a petition last week said the robotic devices are critical to its US semiconductor manufacturing. Without the waiver, Intel would not have been allowed to make software, firmware, and hardware changes for its "Automated Guided Vehicles" that it said could be classified by the agency as robots. Intel told the FCC there is a lack of proven domestic alternatives that meet operational requirements and replacing the automated guided vehicles would take Intel years and could disrupt its manufacturing operations. The company did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The vehicles are used to transport materials within Intel's semiconductor facilities and have been in operation for over two decades, the company said. In July, the FCC barred imports of new Chinese robots and power inverters, seeking to protect the US AI buildout from national security threats and reshore key industries slated for explosive growth. The FCC barred imports of new Chinese humanoid and quadruped robots, in addition to connected power inverters. The FCC has since granted some approvals to allow for continued specific robotic device imports. Some analysts forecast broad adoption of humanoid robots, topped with AI-enabled "brains," in consumer and industrial arenas, while explosive data-center construction in the US will depend on reliable sources of inverters.

item.title: SpaceX says potential Tesla merger would need Elon Musk's approval
item.description: SpaceX said on Thursday its potential merger with Tesla will require controlling investor Elon Musk's approval, even though the entrepreneur has recused himself from talks between his two companies because of conflicts of interest.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: SpaceX (SPCX.O) said on Thursday its potential merger with Tesla (TSLA.O) will require controlling investor Elon Musk's approval, even though the entrepreneur has recused himself from talks between his two companies because of conflicts of interest. Musk, the world's richest person, said on Tuesday [USN:L4N4661M0 TEXT:"a merger of SpaceX and Tesla would be "a good idea""] and that they had formed special committees to discuss a union. In a regulatory filing on Thursday, SpaceX said, "No determination by our special committee has been made regarding any potential combination, and any potential combination would be subject to further approval by our special committee, our board of directors and our controlling shareholder." Several Wall Street analysts have said they see a Tesla-SpaceX merger as a matter of when, not if, but disagree on how much Tesla shareholders should receive in a deal. Musk's public endorsement this week of the potential $3.5 trillion merger has also rattled some insiders involved in the discussions, who worry his comments could invite shareholder scrutiny and delay the process by several weeks, [USN:L6N46716H TEXT:"Reuters reported"] earlier on Thursday. Musk owns nearly a fifth of Tesla and holds voting control at SpaceX. Analysts have said a merger would give him control of the combined entity and could consolidate his influence. The disclosure created a "mess" for the process, as it could lead to questions about how well Tesla shareholders' interests would be represented, a person with direct knowledge of the talks told Reuters. Bringing the companies together [USN:L1N46701K TEXT:"could also simplify decision-making"], as multiple companies require approvals from separate boards and shareholders. The potential merger could give management the flexibility to allocate capital, engineering talent and infrastructure toward more promising projects as firms aggressively push into AI. Tesla on Wednesday cut its annual [USN:L4N4671SD TEXT:"capital expenditure forecast to roughly $20 billion"], down from its previous forecast of more than $25 billion. SpaceX [USN:L4N4661M0 TEXT:"expects $35 billion to $40 billion"] in capital expenditure in the fourth quarter. SpaceX is a major contractor for the US military, intelligence agencies and NASA. Tesla, meanwhile, remains deeply tied to China through its Shanghai factory, which plays a major role in vehicle production and sales. Shares of SpaceX rose about 1%, while those of Tesla fell marginally in extended trading.

item.title: Newmont beats quarterly profit estimates on higher gold prices, Cadia recovery
item.description: Newmont beat analysts' third-quarter profit estimates on Thursday, as elevated gold prices and a recovery in copper production at its Cadia mine in Australia boosted earnings.
item.dc:creator: Varun Sahay, Divya Rajagopal
item.content:encoded: Newmont (NEM.N) beat analysts' third-quarter profit estimates on Thursday, as elevated gold prices and a recovery in copper production at its Cadia mine in Australia boosted earnings. Gold prices averaged $4,204.59 per ounce during the quarter, up about 17.6% from a year earlier, as investors sought safe-haven assets despite a stronger dollar and inflation concerns tied to higher oil prices during the US war on Iran. Quarterly revenue rose 15% to $6.36 billion, while copper production jumped 35% from the previous quarter to 23,000 tonnes as Cadia recovered from a prior-quarter disruption. Shares of the company were up 1.5% in extended trading. Newmont said it was advancing its Red Chris Block Cave joint venture in the British Columbia province of Canada toward a final investment decision in early 2027. The project is expected to produce about 3 million ounces of gold and more than 850,000 tonnes of copper over an initial 13-year cave life. Commercial production is targeted for 2033. The miner, which owns 70% of Red Chris, estimated development capital at $4.2 billion to $4.8 billion, net of an anticipated C$500 million ($356.99 million) contribution from the Canadian government. The company also amended its Nevada Gold Mines joint-venture agreement with Canada's Barrick Mining (ABX.TO) to include Barrick's Fourmile and Newmont's Fiberline and Mike properties, and plans to pay Barrick $1.95 billion in the fourth quarter. CEO Natascha Viljoen said Newmont was not interested in bidding for Australian gold miner Northern Star Resources (NST.AX) , saying its assets did not align with the company's strategy. "It is really hard to find anything better than what we have internally in our own operations," Viljoen said. The company posted adjusted profit of $2.20 per share for the quarter ended September 30, above analysts' average estimate of $2.05 per share, according to data compiled by LSEG. ($1 = 1.4006 Canadian dollars)

item.title: Utilidad neta Grupo Bimbo sube 22.1% tercer trimestre; eleva extremo inferior EBITDA resto del año
item.description: El productor de pan mexicano Grupo Bimbo informó el jueves que sus ganancias netas se incrementaron un 22.1% interanual en el tercer trimestre, a 4,109 millones de pesos (227.2 millones de dólares).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El productor de pan mexicano Grupo Bimbo informó el jueves que sus ganancias netas se incrementaron un 22.1% interanual en el tercer trimestre, a 4,109 millones de pesos (227.2 millones de dólares). Los ingresos totales de Grupo Bimbo (BIMBOA.MX) , con presencia en 99 países, sumaron 106,061 millones de pesos en el periodo, un 1.3% menos que los reportados entre julio y septiembre de 2025. La compañía informó también que elevó el límite inferior de su margen EBITDA ajustado de 70 a 85 puntos básicos, mientras que el límite superior se mantuvo sin cambios en 120 puntos básicos. También mantuvo su previsión de ventas netas para 2026, que apunta a un crecimiento de un dígito medio, y su pronóstico de gastos de capital de entre 1,000 y 1,200 millones de dólares, según informó la dirección durante una teleconferencia tras la presentación de sus resultados del tercer trimestre. De cara a 2027, Grupo Bimbo prevé que continúen beneficiándose de sus "iniciativas de transformación" en Norteamérica, un crecimiento rentable en México y una mejora del rendimiento en Latinoamérica, pero advirtió de un entorno más inflacionario, según señaló JPMorgan. (1 dólar = 18.0808 pesos mexicanos al cierre de septiembre).

item.title: S&P 500 e Nasdaq fecham com forte queda, conforme novas dúvidas sobre IA levam a vendas no setor de tecnologia
item.description: As ações nos EUA fecharam em forte baixa nesta quinta-feira, e o Nasdaq registrou sua maior queda diária desde junho, à medida que uma série de relatórios de resultados financeiros de grande repercussão reacendeu novos temores sobre a corrida por gastos com IA.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: As ações nos EUA fecharam em forte baixa nesta quinta-feira, e o Nasdaq registrou sua maior queda diária desde junho, à medida que uma série de relatórios de resultados financeiros de grande repercussão reacendeu novos temores sobre a corrida por gastos com IA. O S&P 500 encerrou o dia em território profundamente negativo. O Nasdaq, com forte presença de empresas de tecnologia, foi puxado para baixo pelo setor de microchips e registrou a maior queda, caindo 2,6% na esteira de uma enxurrada de resultados financeiros de grande repercussão relacionados à IA. O Dow Jones, índice de blue chips, conseguiu um ganho nominal minutos antes do fechamento do mercado. Os resultados da Meta (META.O) superaram as expectativas dos analistas, mas suas ações tombaram 7,0%, já que a controladora do Facebook registrou seu primeiro fluxo de caixa negativo em mais de uma década devido aos gastos com IA e anunciou planos de emitir ações sem direito a voto em uma divisão de duas por uma para levantar capital a ser investido nessa tecnologia emergente. As ações da Tesla (TSLA.O) caíram 3,1%, embora a fabricante de carros elétricos tenha, inesperadamente, registrado fluxo de caixa livre positivo no trimestre e reduzido seus planos de gastos de capital para 2026. O índice Philadelphia SE Semiconductor (.SOX) , que impulsionou grande parte dos ganhos do atual mercado em alta, despencou 6,7%, sua maior queda percentual diária desde 23 de junho. Com a queda desta quinta-feira, o SOX está mais de 26% abaixo de sua máxima histórica de fechamento, alcançada em 22 de junho, mas ainda apresenta alta de 51,5% no acumulado do ano. O S&P 500 subiu 11,9% no mesmo período. “É um dia maravilhoso em Wall Street”, disse Paul Nolte, consultor sênior de patrimônio e estrategista de mercado da Murphy & Sylvest, em Elmhurst, Illinois. “A única parte do mercado que está realmente sofrendo aqui é a de tecnologia, que tem sido a queridinha dos mercados até mais ou menos junho.” “Os investidores estão começando a perceber que há algumas lacunas na narrativa da IA”, acrescentou Nolte. “E isso está causando impacto nos índices, pois eles têm uma ponderação muito grande no setor de tecnologia.” No cenário geopolítico, os houthis, apoiados pelo Irã, lançaram novos ataques contra alvos sauditas, levando os preços do petróleo bruto à maior alta em cinco meses. Os investidores temem que os conflitos em curso no Oriente Médio possam manter a inflação elevada e forçar o Federal Reserve a continuar aumentando as taxas de juros. Dados do Departamento do Trabalho mostraram que os pedidos iniciais de auxílio-desemprego continuaram oscilando perto dos níveis mais baixos em várias décadas. Sinais de estabilidade no mercado de trabalho permitirão que o Fed se concentre no combate à inflação. Atualmente, os mercados financeiros estão precificando a probabilidade de que o banco central aumente sua taxa básica de juros em mais 25 pontos-base antes do final do ano. O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) teve variação positiva de 0,02%, para 52.867,98 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) caiu 1,21%, para 7.663,43 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) registrou queda de 2,60%, para 26.008,86 pontos.
