A temporada de resultados do terceiro trimestre está em pleno andamento, com 111 das empresas do S&P 500 já tendo divulgado seus resultados. Dessas, 83% superaram as expectativas dos analistas, de acordo com os dados mais recentes da LSEG. A Procter & Gamble (PG.N) alertou que as crescentes pressões de custo teriam um impacto cada vez maior sobre o lucro, mas superou as estimativas dos analistas, levando as ações a uma alta de 5,6% e impulsionando o setor de bens de consumo básico (.SPLRCS) . A Blackstone (BX.N) saltou 8,4%, depois que a empresa afirmou que a ampliação dos spreads de crédito sobre dívidas relacionadas à IA poderia representar uma oportunidade para garantir retornos mais elevados. A Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) subiu 7,0% depois que a empresa aeroespacial e de defesa elevou suas previsões anuais de vendas e lucro. A Spotify (SPOT.N) saltou 11,1% depois que a empresa sueca de streaming de música previu lucro no quarto trimestre acima das estimativas de Wall Street, apostando em seus recursos baseados em IA para impulsionar o crescimento do número de usuários. A Union Pacific (UNP.N) registrou alta de 3,6% após a empresa superar as expectativas nos resultados trimestrais, impulsionados por aumentos nos preços de seus principais produtos, embora a ferrovia tenha sinalizado um impacto negativo devido ao aumento dos preços dos combustíveis. As fabricantes de chips Intel (INTC.O) , AMD (AMD.O) , Sandisk (SNDK.O) e Marvell (MRVL.O) caíram mais de 8% em meio à onda de vendas generalizada no setor de chips.

item.title: US to tighten Ebola screening with new air passenger declarations
item.description: The US government will increase measures aimed at preventing entry by people exposed to Ebola with a new requirement for US-bound air travelers to attest they have not been in the Democratic Republic of Congo in the prior 21 days, according to a memo on Thursday seen by Reuters.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The US government will increase measures aimed at preventing entry by people exposed to Ebola with a new requirement for US-bound air travelers to attest they have not been in the Democratic Republic of Congo in the prior 21 days, according to a memo on Thursday seen by Reuters. The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention in May adopted rules barring airline passengers who have been in the DRC, the center of the 2026 outbreak, in the prior three weeks. The restrictions were extended to US citizens in July. The new CDC order takes effect November 3 and requires all US-bound airline passengers to file digital or paper attestations. Airlines for America, which represents United Airlines (UAL.O) , American Airlines (AAL.O) , Southwest Airlines (LUV.N) and Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) , did not immediately comment. The CDC is holding briefing calls with major US and foreign airlines on Friday to detail how carriers should comply with the new requirements. As part of the Ebola measures, the CDC since earlier this year has also barred foreign nationals from the US if they have been in Uganda or South Sudan in the prior three weeks. The Bundibugyo strain of the virus spread undetected for months before the outbreak was declared in May. It kills about half of those infected and has no approved treatment or vaccine. So far the outbreak is confirmed to have killed about 4,700 people in Africa, according to the Africa CDC. To date, no Ebola cases associated with this outbreak have been reported in the United States, the CDC said.

item.title: Elevada umidade retarda plantio de soja no RS; Emater eleva previsão de produtividade para o trigo
item.description: O plantio de soja do Rio Grande do Sul na safra 2026/27 avançou lentamente nesta semana devido a chuvas, com o importante Estado produtor realizando a semeadura em 3% da área total projetada, abaixo da média histórica para a época, informou a Emater em boletim nesta quinta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O plantio de soja do Rio Grande do Sul na safra 2026/27 avançou lentamente nesta semana devido a chuvas, com o importante Estado produtor realizando a semeadura em 3% da área total projetada, abaixo da média histórica para a época, informou a Emater em boletim nesta quinta-feira. "A elevada umidade do solo e a ocorrência de chuvas frequentes restringiram as janelas de plantabilidade, e as baixas temperaturas e a limitada radiação solar retardaram o desenvolvimento das primeiras lavouras implantadas", afirmou o órgão de assistência técnica vinculado ao governo gaúcho. A média histórica indica plantio em 5% das áreas nesta época. Mas o ritmo está igual ao mesmo período do ano passado. O Rio Grande do Sul tem potencial de ser o quarto maior Estado produtor de soja do Brasil na temporada 2026/27, segundo a primeira estimativa da estatal Conab, divulgada na semana passada. O Estado ficaria atrás de Mato Grosso, Paraná e Goiás. No Paraná, chuvas excessivas associadas ao El Niño também [USN:L1N4660QU TEXT:"reduziram"] os ritmo dos trabalhos de plantio. "Em áreas semeadas antecipadamente, houve prejuízo à emergência após as chuvas volumosas, embora os estandes ainda estejam, em geral, satisfatórios", acrescentou a Emater, que chamou também a atenção para o aparecimento do fungo da ferrugem asiática. A safra gaúcha está estimada pela Conab em 20,2 milhões de toneladas, avanço anual de 8,3%. Com relação ao milho, a Emater afirmou que o plantio avançou em ritmo desigual, atingindo 78% da área do Estado, e que as temperaturas amenas também retardaram o crescimento em algumas regiões. O Rio Grande do Sul é normalmente o principal Estado produtor do cereal na primeira safra e deve colher 6,6 milhões de toneladas, alta de 10,2% ante o ciclo passado, segundo a Conab. TRIGO Embora tenha citado perdas para a safra de trigo em decorrência de chuvas excessivas, a Emater elevou nesta quinta-feira sua projeção de produtividade para a safra do cereal do Estado, afirmando que a projeção inicial considerou resultados de mais perdas em anos de El Niño. A produtividade projetada no início do plantio era de 2.701 kg/hectare, e o cenário atual aponta 2.833 kg/ha, segundo a Emater. Ainda assim, o desempenho indica uma retração de 5,55% em relação ao ano anterior. A safra de trigo, com colheita em andamento, está estimada agora pela Emater em 2,16 milhões de toneladas, o que representa queda de 37,48% no comparativo com o ciclo passado, quando a área plantada foi maior, superando 1 milhão de hectares. O Rio Grande do Sul é um dos principais produtores do Brasil, ao lado do Paraná. Ademais, Neimar Peroni, um dos organizadores do Informativo Conjuntural da Emater, alertou que a empresa poderá revisar para baixo a projeção, caso os resultados esperados no campo não sejam confirmados.

item.title: Gilead to buy PepStar's inflammation drug program in $1.28 billion deal
item.description: Gilead Sciences said on Thursday it will acquire PepStar Therapeutics' oral inflammation drug program, including an experimental bowel disease treatment, for $1.275 billion in cash upfront.
item.dc:creator: Sahil Pandey
item.content:encoded: Gilead Sciences (GILD.O) said on Thursday it will acquire PepStar Therapeutics' oral inflammation drug program, including an experimental bowel disease treatment, for $1.275 billion in cash upfront. The deal follows positive mid-stage [USN:L4N4650Q7 TEXT:"results"] for Gilead's experimental pill for chronic bowel disease, emvistegrast, on Monday and adds the new inflammatory bowel disease candidate to its portfolio. Gilead said it sees potential for HCXT-2001 to be developed on its own or in combination with other programs in its pipeline. Inflammatory bowel disease, or IBD, is a group of long-term conditions in which the immune system causes inflammation in the digestive tract. Gilead said HCXT-2001 is designed to block the IL-23 receptor, part of an immune pathway involved in inflammatory diseases. Citi analyst Geoffrey Meacham said the $1.275 billion upfront payment was notable given that HCXT-2001 remains in early-stage testing and has no published clinical data. Meacham said the acquisition reinforces Gilead's inflammation and immunology strategy while offering an opportunity to diversify its longer-term growth beyond its core HIV business. Gilead said the deal, expected to close in the final quarter of this year, gives it worldwide rights to the program.

item.title: 米国株式市場＝Ｓ＆Ｐ・ナスダック急落、ＡＩ投資巡る懸念再燃
item.description:
Stephen Culp
［ニューヨーク ２２日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合が反...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝Ｓ＆Ｐ・ナスダック急落、ＡＩ投資巡る懸念再燃 5:11 配信

2024年9月18日、米国ニューヨーク市。REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

Stephen Culp

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合が反落。ナスダックは１日の下落率として６月５日以来の大きさを記録した。注目企業の決算発表が相次ぐ中、人工知能（ＡＩ）への投資競争を巡る懸念が再燃した。

一方、優良株で構成するダウ工業株３０種は取引終了の数分前に小幅高に転じた。

フェイスブックの親会社メタ・プラットフォームズは、決算がアナリスト予想を上回ったものの、株価は７．０％下落した。ＡＩ関連支出により１０年以上ぶりにキャッシュフローがマイナスとなったほか、ＡＩ技術への投資資金を調達するため、１対２の株式分割で議決権のない株式を発行する計画を発表した。

電気自動車（ＥＶ）メーカーのテスラは３．１％安。四半期のフリーキャッシュフローが予想外のプラスとなり、２０２６年の設備投資計画を引き下げたものの、売られた。

現在の強気相場を大きくけん引してきたフィラデルフィア半導体指数は６．７％急落し、１日の下落率として６月２３日以来の大きさとなった。

同指数はこの日の下落で、６月２２日に付けた終値ベースの最高値を２６％超下回った。ただ、年初来ではなお５１．５％上昇している。同期間のＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種の上昇率は１１．９％。

マーフィー・アンド・シルベストのシニアウェルスアドバイザー兼市場ストラテジスト、ポール・ノルテ氏は「ウォール街にとっては素晴らしい一日だ。市場で本当に苦戦しているのは、６月ごろまで市場の寵児だったハイテク株だけだ」と指摘。「投資家はＡＩの成長シナリオにいくつかの穴があると気付き始めている。株価指数はハイテク株の比重が非常に大きいため、その影響を受けている」と述べた。

地政学面では、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジアラビアの標的に新たな攻撃を仕掛け、原油価格が５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。投資家は、中東情勢の混乱が続けばインフレが高止まりし、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げ継続を迫られる可能性を懸念した。

米労働省が発表した新規失業保険申請件数は、数十年ぶりの低水準付近での推移が続いた。労働市場の安定を示す兆候は、ＦＲＢがインフレ抑制に注力する余地を与える。金融市場は現在、ＦＲＢが年末までに政策金利をさらに２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き上げる可能性を織り込んでいる。

プロクター・アンド・ギャンブル（Ｐ＆Ｇ）は、コスト上昇圧力が利益を一段と圧迫すると警告したものの、決算がアナリスト予想を上回り、５．６％上昇。主要消費財指数を支えた。

ブラックストーンは８．４％高。ＡＩ関連債務の信用スプレッド拡大が、より高いリターンを確保する機会になり得るとの見方を示した。

航空宇宙・防衛大手ロッキード・マーチンは通期の売上高と利益の見通しを引き上げ、７．０％上昇した。

スウェーデンの音楽配信大手スポティファイは１１．１％上昇。第４・四半期の利益見通しが市場予想を上回った。ＡＩを活用した機能が利用者数の拡大を促すと見込んでいる。

半導体株が幅広く売られる中、インテル、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（ＡＭＤ）、サンディスク、マーベル・テクノロジーはいずれも８％超下落した。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では、値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．０１対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．３７対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合算出来高は１８７億９０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７１億９０００万株。

item.title: Australian agency mulled firing KPMG over data-handling rule breach, documents show
item.description: KPMG Australia breached a contract with the country's biggest federal agency by transferring sensitive government material outside its secure environment, prompting officials to consider firing the firm, documents reviewed by Reuters show.
item.dc:creator: Byron Kaye, Christine Chen
item.content:encoded: KPMG Australia breached a contract with the country's biggest federal agency by transferring sensitive government material outside its secure environment, prompting officials to consider firing the firm, documents reviewed by Reuters show. The incident is the global accounting firm's first apparent violation of client information-handling protocols regarding its vast portfolio of Australian government work — A$650 million ($456 million) in active [USN:L1N42K03U TEXT:"federal contracts"] as of 2026. KPMG's Australian unit has been at the centre of a [USN:L1N42R05P TEXT:"scandal"] over accusations it shared confidential private-sector client information to pitch for work, which it has admitted, but has maintained the conduct did not extend to government contracts. The government incident in late 2025 involved Services Australia, which operates the country's public health and welfare systems and handles data of most of the country's population of 27 million. Both KPMG and Services Australia said in comments to Reuters the matter did not involve any data breach, however the government agency has not awarded any new audit work to the firm since. The incident came to light when a KPMG employee sent a draft audit report marked "OFFICIAL: Sensitive" from a KPMG email account rather than from a specifically-assigned account for Services Australia. "It appears KPMG has taken agency materials outside of the network which is in breach of their obligations under the contract," a director of the Services Australia audit branch wrote to the agency's national audit manager, Sally Bond, in a December 17 email obtained under Freedom of Information law. The director, whose name was redacted, recommended the agency demand an explanation from KPMG then "assess whether any further action is required ... including termination of contracts, noting there is no remedy available for a breach of this nature". Bond wrote to KPMG a week later saying "information was transferred outside of the Services Australia environment by KPMG during our engagement", adding the transferral was "explicitly prohibited under the contract". "Services Australia takes a breach of this nature extremely seriously," Bond wrote in the email dated December 23. "We will be in parallel engaging with our relevant agency teams to undertake a review of the situation." In an email the same day to another Services Australia general manager, Bond wrote that the information taken outside the government system was not of "particular concern", but said: "I am more concerned that KPMG has acted outside the contract and has not taken any proactive steps to assure us of this fact". In a response to Bond on December 23, KPMG said the only document transferred outside the agency was an internal audit report template which had been deleted, and the KPMG employee involved would face follow-up action, including additional training. The documents didn't show whether Services Australia took additional measures, but an internal cybersecurity review into the incident concluded in January that the risk of data breach was low and closed it off. NO NEW AUDIT WORK FOR KPMG FROM SERVICES AUSTRALIA KPMG said in a statement to Reuters it "confirmed with Services Australia that no confidential information was exchanged and reminded our people of their obligations in relation to data protocols". A Services Australia spokesperson told Reuters KPMG had "used its own network and email system, rather than the agency's, to develop and distribute a draft internal audit report", but the incident did not amount to a data breach. The agency "considered the available contractual options", the spokesperson added. Since "the work was substantially complete and remedial action had been taken, the agency finalised the engagement rather than terminate the contract". "This was the only instance of this type occurring and Services Australia has not awarded KPMG additional internal audit work since the incident," they said. The agency gave KPMG an A$12 million multi-year contract in 2024 for "program assurance services", and in April awarded the firm an A$69,850 contract to provide actuarial services, according to published government tender data. Gary Monroe, a University of New South Wales professor who specialises in audit, said regardless of what material was taken outside the government system, "it's a breach of trust with the client". On Thursday, the government said it had [USN:L1N468031 TEXT:"extended"] a ban on KPMG bidding for new federal work until February 28, while the firm fixes cultural and governance weaknesses. ($1 = 1.4247 Australian dollars)

item.title: 米ロッキード、国防総省にＦ３５を850機供給で合意 通期業績見通し引き上げ
item.description:
Mike Stone Aatreyee Dasgupta
[２２日 ロイター] - 米防衛機器大手ロッキード・マーチン...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ロッキード、国防総省にＦ３５を850機供給で合意　通期業績見通し引き上げ 5:08 配信

米防衛機器大手ロッキード・マーチンのロゴ。2025年7月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Mike Stone　Aatreyee Dasgupta

[２２日 ロイター] - 米防衛機器大手ロッキード・マーチンは２２日、通期の売上高と利益の見通しを上方修正した。米国防総省に「Ｆ３５ライトニングⅡ」戦闘機を今後１０年間に少なくとも８５０機供給する枠組み合意も発表した。

同戦闘機は最も低価格な機種で１機当たり９２００万ドルであるため、１０年間の枠組み合意では少なくとも７８２億ドル相当に達する見込みだ。海兵隊向けの短距離離陸・垂直着陸が可能な「Ｆ３５Ｂ」は１億２１００万ドル、海軍向け「Ｆ３５Ｃ」は１億１０００万ドル。契約における機種構成は不明で、価格はインフレや人件費の上昇に伴って上がると予想される。

また同社は、２０２６年通期の売上高は約８００億─８２０億ドルになるとの見通しを示し、従来の７９７億５０００万─８１７億５０００万ドルから引き上げた。通期の１株当たり利益見通しも、従来の２９．９５─３０．６５ドルから３０．３５─３０．７５ドルに引き上げた。

２６年のフリーキャッシュフロー見通しも、従来の７０億─７２億ドルから約７８億─８０億ドルに引き上げた。

併せて発表した第３・四半期（９月２７日終了）の売上高は１１％増の２０７億１０００万ドル。ミサイル部門の売上高がＰＡＣ３とＴＨＡＡＤの増産で２４％伸びたほか、Ｆ３５とＣ１３０プログラムで航空部門も１３％増加したのが寄与した。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想は２０５億１０００万ドルだった。

同四半期の１株当たり利益は７．９７ドルで、アナリスト予想の７．４３ドルを上回った。

エバン・スコット最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）はロイターに対し、第４・四半期の設備投資増加は、弾薬生産能力の拡大に向けた投資が主因になるとの見方を示した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 アングル：米国防総省のアンソロピック追放、小規模ＡＩライバルに想定外の商機 最終更新: 10/23(金) 5:08 ロイター

item.title: トランプ氏、住宅保有コスト引き下げに大統領令署名 ローン負担軽減など
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２２日、一戸建て住宅の保有や住宅ローンに伴うコストの軽減を目指す大統領令に署名した。ホワイトハウスが発表した。

大統領令は、借り手が現在の市場価値に基づく自己資本比率の要件を満たした場合、住宅ローン保険料を自動的に打ち切る試験プログラムの開始を連邦住宅金融庁（ＦＨＦＡ）に指示するもの。また、借り換え時の権原保険を免除するＦＨＦＡの試験制度も恒久化する。

このほか、連邦政府の支援対象となる工場生産型住宅の普及拡大に向け、「住宅イノベーション・タスクフォース」を設置。農務長官と退役軍人省長官に対し、それぞれの省が提供する一戸建て住宅向け融資の金利引き下げに取り組むことも指示した。

item.title: Apple launches into foldable market as iPhone Duo sales begin
item.description: Sales of Apple's first folding phone, the iPhone Duo, began on Friday, with market watchers betting on whether the device can reinvent the small foldables market just like the iPhone did for smartphones.
item.dc:creator: Aditya Soni
item.content:encoded: Sales of Apple's (AAPL.O) first folding phone, the iPhone Duo, began on Friday, with market watchers betting on whether the device can reinvent the small foldables market just like the iPhone did for smartphones. The Duo's reception could prove an early test for new CEO John Ternus, the former hardware chief who unveiled the phone barely a week after taking charge in September. It could also have large implications for a niche category in which rivals such as Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and Huawei Technologies have sold premium offerings for several years. Within minutes of pre-orders opening last Friday, Apple's estimated delivery dates for the Duo had slipped to late January as demand outpaced supply. The US company called the response from customers "nothing short of extraordinary." In Sydney, the first Apple store to sell the phones on Friday, a queue of customers formed outside before opening at 8 a.m. local time (2100 GMT). Simon Krishnan, a 48-year-old engineer, paid A$3,899 ($2,734) for a Duo with 512GB memory. "This is a bit of a luxury item for me, because it's so expensive, but I just think, you know what? Life's too short," he said. MIXED REVIEWS Early reviews have praised the Duo's design as well as its sturdy and barely visible hinge, a major feat for phones whose prominent creased screen has long been a drawback and potential deterrent for buyers. But reviewers have said camera compromises including the absence of a telephoto lens and third-party apps that still need to be reworked for the new display size could disappoint some buyers. They have also said the Duo in its smaller, folded state is less handy for the litany of quick tasks that most users carry out each day on standard iPhones, with several prominent reviewers recommending against the Duo for many Apple customers. "It's been a lot of fun trying the Duo out for a week, but it feels like I've gotten to use an extraordinarily polished prototype  —  not a finished product that I'd want to buy and carry," longtime Apple commentator John Gruber, author of the blog Daring Fireball, wrote in a review. Tech commentator Marques Brownlee, popularly known as MKBHD, said in a YouTube review that "if you're just a regular person who doesn't do much more than texting, social media and browsing here and there, then it is probably a no. But if the $2,000 doesn't mean much to you, and you like the idea, after the learning curve and getting used to not having facial identification, it is a really fun phone." TOUGH TO FIND The limited supplies could disappoint Apple fans lining up in front of stores to buy the Duo. Apple told Reuters that walk-in availability would vary by country, with limited stocks in the US, Australia, Canada, Mexico and much of Britain and Europe. In China, France, Hong Kong, India and Japan, units would be available only for customers who had ordered online. In the China-governed territory of Macau, where the iPhone Duo will be available for walk-in customers only, fans lined up hours in advance of the store opening, social media posts and media reports showed. "Foldables have been an established category for years, but adoption has remained relatively limited compared with conventional smartphones. Apple's entry could bring the format to a much broader audience," said Francisco Jeronimo, vice president at market researcher IDC. IDC expects Apple will take 44% of the foldable value in 2026 on 31% of foldable units. By 2027, it will become the market leader in the category both in value and units shipped, IDC forecast. "Apple has made a convincing case for this form factor," Jeronimo said after spending a week with the passport-shaped Duo. "Now comes the next test: turning excitement into availability, adoption and a lasting new chapter for the smartphone market," Jeronimo said. ($1 = 1.4257 Australian dollars)

item.title: Trump says wind turbine imports threaten national security
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Thursday declared imports of wind turbines and their components a threat to national security, but stopped short of imposing new tariffs on the sector.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Thursday declared imports of wind turbines and their components a threat to national security, but stopped short of imposing new tariffs on the sector. In a White House proclamation, Trump said a Commerce Department investigation found that imported wind turbines threatened national security due to cybersecurity concerns tied to foreign-made equipment, interference with radar systems and air traffic operations, and an increased US reliance on goods made overseas. The move responds to a probe [USN:L1N3UD0KZ TEXT:"launched"] in August 2025 under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act. It is one of numerous trade investigations the administration has conducted into the national security ramifications of imports across an array of sectors. Instead of ordering immediate trade restrictions, Trump directed trade officials to pursue negotiations with trading partners and report back within 180 days. Additional trade measures, including tariffs, could be considered later, the order said. The order repeats Trump's longstanding criticism of wind energy as being unreliable because it is intermittent. "Given wind energy’s intermittent reliability, use of wind energy diverts the United States electrical grid from more reliable energy sources," the order said. Major suppliers of wind turbines and components to the United States include Mexico, France, India, Denmark and Germany, according to trade data cited by the center-right think tank American Action Forum. A spokesperson for the American Clean Power Association, a trade group representing clean energy companies, was not immediately available for comment.

item.title: 米ＦＣＣ、中国ファーウェイ子会社製半導体搭載2製品販売禁止 新規則初適用
item.description:
David Shepardson
[ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] - 米連邦通信委員会（ＦＣＣ）は２２日、中国の通...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＦＣＣ、中国ファーウェイ子会社製半導体搭載2製品販売禁止　新規則初適用 4:53 配信

７月２２日撮影　REUTERS/Kylie Cooper

David Shepardson

[ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] - 米連邦通信委員会（ＦＣＣ）は２２日、中国の通信機器大手、華為技術（ファーウェイ）の子会社が製造した監視向け半導体が搭載された２製品について、米国内での販売を禁止したと発表した。ＦＣＣが新たな規則に基づく権限を行使したのは今回が初めて。

ＦＣＣが販売を禁止したのは、ダッシュボードカメラと無線映像送信機。いずれもファーウェイ子会社のハイシリコンが製造した半導体が搭載されている。ハイシリコンはこの半導体を「監視市場向けに設計されている」と宣伝しているほか、「人の顔を検知するアルゴリズム」を備えていると説明しているという。

この件について、ファーウェイとハイシリコンからコメントは得られていない。

item.title: 原油先物4％高、5カ月ぶり高値 サウジ攻撃で供給懸念
item.description:
Scott DiSavino
［ニューヨーク ２２日 ロイター］ - 米国時間の原油先物は、北海ブレント先物が約４％...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
原油先物4％高、5カ月ぶり高値　サウジ攻撃で供給懸念 4:47 配信

2020年4月21日、米国オクラホマ州で撮影。REUTERS/Drone Base/File Photo

Scott DiSavino

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 米国時間の原油先物は、北海ブレント先物が約４％上昇し、５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアでの攻撃を受け、主要なエネルギー輸出地域からの供給に一段の混乱が生じるとの懸念が強まった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が４．３５ドル（４．０％）高の１バレル＝１１３．１７ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は２．３２ドル（２．４％）高の９９．４７ドルだった。

ブレントは５月４日以来の高値で取引を終えた。テクニカル指標では、この１週間で３度目の買われ過ぎの状態となった。

エネルギー助言会社リターブッシュ・アンド・アソシエーツのアナリストはリポートで「米中間選挙後に米国とイスラエルがイランを共同攻撃するとの観測が浮上する中、フーシ派によるサウジのインフラへの追加攻撃でリスクプレミアムが再び大きく上乗せされ、原油相場は反発している」と指摘した。

item.title: 仏大統領、「正当性ない」抗議活動禁止へ 暴動は「極左に責任」
item.description:
Michel Rose
[パリ ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Michel Rose

[パリ　２２日　 ロイター] - フランスのマクロン大統領は２２日、教育環境の改善などを求める大規模な抗議デモが各地で続く中、「正当性のない」抗議活動を向こう数日以内に禁止すると表明した。また、先週末に発生した暴動や略奪は極左の「扇動的な」団体や破壊行為者に責任があるとの認識を示した。

マクロン氏はこの日、情報機関トップや主要閣僚との会合を実施。会合後に記者団に対し「１７日に国家の転覆を目的とする極左団体による政治的かつ扇動的な行為があった」と述べ、労働組合などが主催するデモについては実施を認めるものの、商店などを保護するためデモ隊のルート変更を求める可能性があると語った。

ダルマナン法相は、デモ参加禁止命令に違反した人の選挙権停止のほか、暴力行為や略奪、警察への攻撃に関与した人に対するソーシャルメディアの利用制限を導入したい考えを示した。

地元当局によると、フランス第２、第３の都市であるマルセイユとリヨンで２４日に予定されていた全ての抗議活動は禁止されている。ただ、フランス最大の学生組合ＵＮＥＦは２４日に集会を呼びかけているほか、２０１８年に発足した反体制運動「黄色いベスト運動」もパリ中心部を行進する計画を届け出るなど、新たな抗議活動の動きは広がりつつある。

２２日はパリで予定されていた学生による抗議集会が当初は禁止されたが、その後実施が認められた。ただ、無許可の集会が開かれる可能性が警戒される中、公共交通当局はパリ中心部の複数の地下鉄駅を閉鎖している。

item.title: Trump signs order aimed at reducing single-family housing costs
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Thursday signed an executive order aimed at reducing expenses for homeowners by lowering insurance premiums, refinancing costs and interest rates on certain government-backed home loans, the White House said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Thursday signed an executive order aimed at reducing expenses for homeowners by lowering insurance premiums, refinancing costs and interest rates on certain government-backed home loans, the White House said. High home prices and elevated mortgage rates have put pressure on the Trump administration to deliver meaningful relief as affordability has emerged as a political vulnerability for Republicans ahead of the November midterm elections. Trump's order directs the Federal Housing Finance Agency to launch a pilot program to cancel borrowers' mortgage insurance premiums once they meet equity requirements based on current market values. It also makes permanent an FHFA pilot program waiving title insurance requirements for mortgage refinancings. In addition, the order establishes a task force on manufactured housing innovation to expand factory-built homes eligible for federal housing programs, and directs the agriculture and veterans affairs secretaries to reduce interest rates on single-family home loans issued by their departments. Contracts to buy previously owned US homes plunged to a [USN:L1N4650NQ TEXT:"record low"] in September as rising mortgage rates depressed demand for housing, according to the National Association of Realtors. US single-family housing starts [USN:L1N4650SY TEXT:"fell 4.6%"] in September, while permits for future construction dropped 4% to their lowest level in 3-1/2 years, underscoring the challenges facing the housing market as borrowing costs rise. The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate last week reached 7.40%, the highest in about three years, before falling to 7.32% this week, according to Freddie Mac. The yield on the 10-year Treasury note, which acts as a pricing benchmark for mortgages, has fallen by more than a quarter percentage point in the last two weeks.

item.title: Juventus salvage Rennes draw as Benfica, Leverkusen stay perfect
item.description: Juventus dropped their first points of the Europa League campaign after coming from behind to draw 2-2 with visitors Rennes on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Juventus dropped their first points of the Europa League campaign after coming from behind to draw 2-2 with visitors Rennes on Thursday. Benfica went top of the standings with a 4-1 demolition of Omonia in Cyprus, after Bayer Leverkusen had also moved onto nine points with a 2-0 win at OFI in Crete. Bournemouth also maintained their perfect start with a 3-0 victory over 10-man AC Milan. Olympiacos and Ferencvaros made it three wins from three as well, beating Sparta Prague 1-0 and Torreense 4-1 respectively. Zeki Celik gave Juventus a fifth-minute lead, but the French side kept their composure and were level 10 minutes later when Jordan international Musa Al-Taamari finished from close range for his first goal in the competition. Rennes then stunned the hosts with a Boulaye Dia penalty two minutes before the break as the Italians struggled to create chances until Nick Woltemade equalised from the spot in the 67th minute. The German forward twice went close to scoring again as Luciano Spalletti's team upped the pressure, and Juve thought they had won it in the 88th minute when Jhon Lucumi found the net from close range, but his effort was ruled out for offside. The draw at least spared Juventus a second successive defeat following Sunday's 3-0 home [USN:L6N46407C TEXT:"loss"] to Lazio in Serie A. Jonas Hofmann made the most of his surprise start for Bayer Leverkusen, scoring twice in three minutes to give the Bundesliga side a 2-0 victory at OFI. OFI, who stunned Hoffenheim 2-0 in their opening league-phase match, were twice caught napping by Hofmann, who was added to the side following an injury to Martin Terrier. Bournemouth took control against Milan through first-half penalties from Justin Kluivert and Marcus Tavernier before Amine Adli added a third in the 84th minute. Milan goalkeeper Mike Maignan was sent off in the 28th minute. Hoffenheim beat Olympique Lyonnais 3-0 to claim their first win of the competition, but the victory was overshadowed by an injury to Lyon defender Steeve Kango. Kango fell awkwardly after an aerial challenge and was carried off on a stretcher wearing a neck brace before being taken to hospital for checks.

item.title: 欧州市場サマリー（22日）
item.description:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞
反落して取引を終えた。原油高やそれに伴うインフレへの懸念が強まる中、銀行や鉱業株の売り注文が優...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（22日） 4:14 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

反落して取引を終えた。原油高やそれに伴うインフレへの懸念が強まる中、銀行や鉱業株の売り注文が優勢だった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．９３％下落した。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は２．５４％安。四半期決算の利益が市場予想を下回った銀行大手バークレイズは２．３％安。約５０００人の人員削減計画を発表した。

金や銅の値下がりを受けて、ＦＴＳＥ３５０種貴金属株指数は５．２１％、鉱業株指数は３．９７％それぞれ下落。銅大手アントファガスタは６．２％、資源大手アングロ・アメリカンは５．６％、リオ・ティントは３．４％いずれも値を下げた。

一方、製薬大手アストラゼネカは２．９％、ＧＳＫは２．５％それぞれ上昇。英日用品のユニリーバは３．２％高。

直近四半期の売上高の伸びが鈍化したスーパーマーケット大手セインズベリーは２．２％安。ホテル経営大手のインターコンチネンタル・ホテルズ・グループ（ＩＨＧ）は２．７％安。

ロンドン証券取引所グループ（ＬＳＥＧ）は７．７％高。金融データ企業の買収で合意したことが好材料視された。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

反落して取引を終えた。銀行株の売り注文が目立った。原油高やフランス国債利回りの上昇も相場の重荷となった。

ＳＴＯＸＸユーロ圏銀行株指数は４．１７％安。四半期決算を発表したスペインの銀行バンキンターは７．６％下落。英銀大手バークレイズは２．３％安。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州高級品株１０種指数は０．９１％安。足元の売上高が市場予想に届かずフランスの高級ブランド大手エルメスは４．９％下落した。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は２．０４％安。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への懸念が再燃し、欧州の半導体大手ＳＴマイクロエレクトロニクスは４．９％、オランダの半導体製造装置メーカーＡＳＭＬホールディングは５．０％、ドイツの半導体大手インフィニオン・テクノロジーズは６．０％いずれも下落した。

一方、食品・飲料株指数は１．９２％高。売上高の伸び率が市場予想を上回ったスイスの食品大手ネスレは１．１％上昇した。ヘルスケア株指数は２．０７％上昇。堅調な業績予想を示したベルギーのバイオ医薬品グループ、ユーシービーは２１．６％高だった。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

独仏１０年債利回り格差が１５年ぶりの高水準に拡大した。フランスの厳しい財政状況と抗議デモ継続への懸念が投資家心理を圧迫した。

フランスの指標１０年債利回りは終盤、６．５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の５．０６％。一時は５．１４１５％と、２００２年７月以来の高水準を付けた。

安全資産とされるドイツ国債との利回り格差は１７７．７ｂｐと、ユーロ圏債務危機下の２０１１年１１月以来の水準に拡大。フランスの財政見通しに対する投資家の不安を浮き彫りにした。

ユーロ圏の指標となる独１０年債利回りは７ｂｐ低下の３．３４％。原油価格が上昇する中でも、安全資産需要が独国債を支えた。

独国債に対する利回り格差はユーロ圏全体で拡大した。ベルギーは１０ｂｐ拡大の１１０ｂｐと、２０１２年以来の高水準となった。イタリアは１０．５ｂｐ拡大の１２３ｂｐ、スペインは６ｂｐ拡大の７０ｂｐ、ギリシャは８．５ｂｐ拡大の１０６ｂｐだった。

金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りは６ｂｐ低下し、３．０２％となった。

短期金融市場が終盤に織り込む２７年末のＥＣＢ中銀預金金利は３．１５％。０．２５％ポイントの利上げを２回実施し、３回目を実施する確率が８０％であることを示している。

ユーロ圏金融・債券市場：[DE/BJ]

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝円が大幅高、原油高やＡＩ収益懸念で安全資産買い
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２２日 ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、円が１日としては約１カ月ぶりの大幅上昇となる見...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝円が大幅高、原油高やＡＩ収益懸念で安全資産買い 4:03 配信

2026年10月20日撮影 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon/Illustration

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、円が１日としては約１カ月ぶりの大幅上昇となる見通し。株式市場の不安定な動きや中東での戦争長期化に伴う原油高、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資の将来の収益性に対する疑念を背景に、投資家が安全資産を求めた。

円は対ドルで０．７５％上昇し、１ドル＝１５６．９６円となった。

円相場の動きの一部は、重要な節目である１ドル＝１６０円に近づいていたことも背景にある可能性がある。この水準に近づくほど、日本当局が円を下支えするため再び介入する可能性が高まると見られている。

ドルは、円と同様に伝統的な安全資産とされるスイスフランに対して０．４２％下落し、１ドル＝０．８２１フランとなった。

円やユーロなど主要通貨に対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．０８％低下し、１０１．６０。

ユーロは０．０９％下落し、１ユーロ＝１．１２２２ドルとなった。

ウェルズ・ファーゴのグローバル為替戦略責任者、エリック・ネルソン氏は「米国のＡＩ関連企業の信用力とフランスの国家としての信用力という、それぞれの弱点を巡る材料がせめぎ合っている。ここ数日は、どちらへの懸念が強いかによって相場が左右されている。フランスへの懸念が米国のＡＩ関連企業の信用力への懸念を上回る限り、ユーロは相対的に軟調に推移するだろう」と語った。

フランスが巨額の債務負担に対処できるかどうかへの懸念が同国の国債を圧迫し、債務水準が高い他のユーロ圏諸国への不安も高めている。

英ポンドは０．０５％上昇し、１ポンド＝１．３４０１ドル。豪ドルは０．１１％下落し、１豪ドル＝０．７０１９米ドルとなった。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは４．２７％下落し、８万１０２３ドルとなった。

item.title: Rooney labels Man United players 'selfish' after Fernandes criticism
item.description: Manchester United's all-time leading scorer Wayne Rooney called the club's players "selfish" and said they were "like babies" after captain Bruno Fernandes questioned the coaching staff's tactics following Wednesday's 4-1 Champions League thrashing by Como.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Manchester United's all-time leading scorer Wayne Rooney called the club's players "selfish" and said they were "like babies" after captain [USN:L6N4671CM TEXT:"Bruno Fernandes questioned"] the coaching staff's tactics following Wednesday's 4-1 Champions League [USN:L6N46717X TEXT:"thrashing by Como"]. Fernandes said United failed to apply enough pressure and adopted a "mood of defeat" after conceding in the second minute, as the heavy loss intensified scrutiny of manager Michael Carrick. United's collapse at Como left them staring at another damaging defeat, with only a stoppage-time goal from Joshua Zirkzee reducing the margin of loss. The criticism follows signs of growing frustration within the squad. Earlier this month, [USN:L8N4612C3 TEXT:"defender Lisandro Martinez criticised"] the club's hierarchy after a 2-0 Champions League defeat by Atletico Madrid, saying he expected greater investment to help the team compete at the highest level. "When Martinez came out, I said this is an absolute nightmare because it will rip the dressing room apart," Rooney told the United Stand podcast on Thursday. "That was the start. We've seen it now with Bruno and you're going to see it with more players because they don't want to take responsibility. "You can say whether Bruno was right or wrong in what he said but you have to take responsibility on the pitch. You have to take responsibility as a group of players. "These players, they're selfish. They don't care about their teammates, don't care about the manager, the staff or the fans, they care about themselves. "If they're not getting what's right for them, they're like babies and just throw. their toys out of the pram and go and deflect the blame on to anyone else but themselves." Carrick, a former United midfielder who played alongside Rooney at Old Trafford, was appointed on an interim basis following [USN:L1N3Y607S TEXT:"Ruben Amorim's dismissal"] in January before [USN:L1N41Z0BH TEXT:"earning a contract through 2028"] after overseeing a dramatic improvement in results. Carrick is under growing pressure with United winless in seven matches across all competitions. They are 20th in the Champions League standings and 13th in the Premier League.

item.title: 銀行の自国国債保有制限案「時期尚早」、長期金利上昇が目下の問題＝伊中銀総裁
item.description: [ローマ ２２日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行 （ＥＣＢ ）理事会メンバーのパネッタ・イタリア中銀総裁は２２日、銀行に...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
銀行の自国国債保有制限案「時期尚早」、長期金利上昇が目下の問題＝伊中銀総裁 3:33 配信

写真はパネッタ・イタリア中銀総裁。フランス・パリで５月撮影。REUTERS/Tom Nicholson

[ローマ　２２日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行 （ＥＣＢ ）理事会メンバーのパネッタ・イタリア中銀総裁は２２日、銀行による自国国債の保有を制限するという案は時期尚早であり、有益でないとの考えを示した。

銀行が多額の国債を保有すると金利上昇に対して脆弱になり、銀行と国家財政の「負の連鎖」を招く危険性は広く議論されており、一部のエコノミストは、銀行が自国の国債に対するエクスポージャーを制限することを提案している。

パネッタ氏はトリノで開催された経済フォーラムで、こうした提案は「やや時期尚早である」と指摘。２０１１─１２年のユーロ圏債務危機当時よりも銀行の財務体質は強化されており、資本準備金に対する国債保有比率もはるかに低いと述べた。

現在の問題は長期金利の上昇にあり、こうした状況下で長期国債の購入余地を制限することは賢明でないと述べた。さらに、監督当局は銀行が国債や金利リスクに過度にさらされていないかを既に監視していると説明。その上で「現時点でこの議論を行うことはあまり有意義ではないと思う」と述べた。

item.title: Steep bill for AI buildout punishes Meta, other tech favorites
item.description: The pullback is the latest test for the AI trade, focusing on the rising costs of a long-term project the payoffs from which remain uncertain and will likely be unevenly distributed.
item.dc:creator: Lewis Krauskopf, Sudeshna Ghoshal
item.content:encoded: The tab for the next round of the AI buildout came due on Thursday. Investors sold shares of Meta Platforms (META.O) and a wealth of companies central to the AI trade, a day after Meta — one of the hyperscalers spending billions to build data centers and other infrastructure supporting the AI boom — said it would issue a new class of shares that will help it raise funds. Meta fell 7%, its largest drop since July. SpaceX (SPCX.O) declined 9% and semiconductor company Nvidia (NVDA.O) — a bellwether of the AI trade — dropped 4%. The Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) lost 2.6%, its largest decline since June 5. Sentiment was also hurt by a 12% plunge in shares of semiconductor company Lam Research (LRCX.O) following its results. The Philadelphia Semiconductor index (.SOX) lost 6.7%. The pullback is the latest test for the AI trade as investors focus on the rising costs of long-term projects where the payoff remains uncertain. Tech firms have borrowed huge sums over the past year for AI spending, but Wall Street now expects that the rise in borrowing costs will motivate tech companies like Meta to sell billions of dollars in stock to fund the next round of building. That dilution could put pressure on share prices, and is a potentially unwelcome development when major US stock indexes remain near all-time highs despite a punishing month of volatile trading. RETURN ON INVESTMENT CONCERNS Selling started with "the big question about the (return on investment) on all the spending," said Matthew Maley, chief market strategist at Miller Tabak. "It's just becoming more and more evident to people that it's going to take a lot longer." Thomas Hayes, chairman at Great Hill Capital LLC in New York, agreed that ROI concerns are central while also citing remarks by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang about a financing bottleneck for smaller AI companies as contributing to the selling. Meta said on Wednesday it would use new Class C shares, which hold no voting power, to [USN:l4n4671s3 TEXT:"fund AI spending and other priorities"]. Meta also raised the low end of its annual spending forecast to $135 billion from $130 billion, with the high end unchanged at $145 billion. That level of spending will require lots of investor participation in coming stock sales. Meta reported negative free cash flow of $2.12 billion in the third quarter, compared with positive free cash flow of $10.63 billion a year earlier. It was the first cash burn at Meta in more than a decade. “More spending, negative free cash flow, not enough revenue being generated from the spend (is) concerning investors that this is just sort of a bit of a money pit,” said Robert Pavlik, senior portfolio manager at Dakota Wealth in Fairfield, Connecticut. The action highlights concern over how AI investment will be paid for. Credit default swaps, which track perceived default risk for the debt of the biggest AI players, have largely risen over the past year, with Meta’s hitting a record on Thursday . INVESTOR ANXIETY SHOWS Fresh signs of market anxiety over AI spending snowballed into a broad market selloff Thursday, with some saying an AI pullback could hit US growth. Investors sought the safety of Treasury bonds, sending those prices higher . "This is your classic rotation day,” said Joe Saluzzi, partner, co-founder and co-head of equity trading at Themis Trading in Chatham, New Jersey. “You can see the money going into Treasuries, so it's a classic safety move ... They are rotating out of techs, out of the AIs, and into the more safety trades, whether it's bonds or some of those big Dow Jones stocks.” Thursday’s selloff added to the pressure on the neocloud companies at the heart of the AI buildout, with Nebius (NBIS.O) off 7% after announcing a new $3.5 billion credit line from Citigroup and CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , whose unsecured bond yields soared to 15% in last week’s AI selloff, down 10%. Bank of America analyst Tal Liani said in a report on Thursday he is maintaining a buy rating and a price target of $140 on CoreWeave stock heading into next month’s earnings report, though he said he believes the firm will need to raise $20 billion to fund commitments to customers — the sort of prospect that is generating anxiety among tech investors. "Nobody is worried about Meta or Amazon or Google getting the financing they need," Maley said. "But if it gets prohibitive for smaller companies, then you don't have to have an implosion of things to make people nervous."

item.title: Tesla cuts capex plan to $20 billion, raising doubts over AI ambitions
item.description: Tesla cut its annual capital expenditure plan to around $20 billion from over $25 billion, raising concerns about delays in Elon Musk's AI, robotaxi and humanoid robotics ambitions.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: Tesla Inc pulled back its spending plans after investment last quarter trailed expectations, clouding Elon Musk’s effort to transform the electric vehicle maker into an AI and robotics company. Capital expenditures will be around $20 billion this year, the company said late Wednesday after reporting earnings results. That marked a reversal from earlier this year, when Tesla raised the target to more than $25 billion. Tesla had been consistently short of the pace needed to hit its spending goal, particularly after a $4.73 billion outlay in the third quarter. Analysts had expected $7.95 billion on average in estimates compiled by Bloomberg. Heavy spending is needed to help Tesla reorient its operations around futuristic business lines such as artificial intelligence, Optimus humanoid robots and autonomous driving. The shift is seen as a central justification for a potential merger with SpaceX — a historic transaction that Musk this week said the firms are exploring. “For almost any company, spending less and generating cash is good news. Tesla is the exception because the stock is not priced as a car company,” said Dave Mazza, chief executive officer of Roundhill Investments. “Capex is the only hard number investors have for how fast Optimus and Cybercab are actually being built, and cutting the guide by $5 billion six months after raising it by $5 billion looks less like discipline and more like the ramp slipping for the future.” The capex figure was a notable surprise in a quarter that also saw Tesla beat analysts’ profit estimates and tout rising customer demand for its automated-driving software. Adjusted earnings were 48 cents a share in the period, while Wall Street had anticipated 44 cents on average. Revenue of $28.05 billion was slightly below expectations. The company’s initiatives are currently supported by a narrow product lineup that consists of only three consumer vehicles: the Y and 3 models, along with the polarizing Cybertruck. Competition for EVs is also heating up. Tesla ended the quarter with the largest passenger vehicle backlog in four years, citing battery availability as a limiting factor. On the call with analysts on Wednesday, Chief Financial Officer Vaibhav Taneja said capital expenditures will continue to grow as Tesla invests in its robotaxi fleet and expands production for the humanoid robot and solar products. It’s also spending on improving computing infrastructure and building a semiconductor plant. Musk tempered expectations around the timeline for Optimus, citing supply-chain challenges, the need for more training data and continued difficulties with the hand design. It will likely take until the end of 2027 for Tesla to work through the various issues, he said. “Lower capex is only positive if it doesn’t come at the expense of future growth,” said Haris Khurshid, chief investment officer at Karobaar Capital. “Given how much their future valuation depends on robotaxi and Optimus, I want to know whether the spending is simply shifting between quarters or whether the ramp is taking longer than expected.”

item.title: Merck/Moderna cancer vaccine cuts melanoma death or recurrence risk by 42%, shares fall
item.description: Moderna and Merck said on Thursday that their mRNA cancer vaccine when combined with Merck's widely used immunotherapy cut the risk of melanoma death or recurrence by 42% in a large trial, potentially paving the way for a new era of personalized treatment.
item.dc:creator: Michael Erman, Julie Steenhuysen
item.content:encoded: Moderna (MRNA.O) and Merck (MRK.N) said on Thursday that their mRNA cancer vaccine when combined with Merck's widely used immunotherapy cut the risk of melanoma death or recurrence by 42% in a large trial, potentially paving the way for a new era of personalized treatment. Moderna shares have soared since the companies in August announced the trial's success without the actual data, nearly quadrupling through Wednesday's close. They closed more than 17% lower after the results leaked on an oncology website earlier on Thursday. Merck shares closed down about 1.8%. The data from the Phase 3 trial of more than 1,100 patients also showed that the combination cut the risk of the cancer's spread by 38%. It is the first data to show that the combination of a vaccine based on mutations unique to each patient's tumor plus a drug that helps the immune system fight cancer can keep the disease at bay. The vaccine, known as intismeran autogene, was tested along with Merck's blockbuster immunotherapy Keytruda, among the world's biggest-selling medicines. Some analysts said the data may raise concerns among investors about how broadly the technology may extend to other cancers. Keytruda works by removing a natural brake cancer cells use to hide from immune system attack, while the vaccine instructs the patient's cells to produce copies of specific mutations for the immune system to seek and destroy. Moderna CEO Stephane Bancel said the data signaled a new chapter in cancer treatment. "With this ability to create new T cells that are specific to your tumor... the clinical impact is very profound, and as we saw in the Phase 2 (trial), very lasting," Bancel said in an interview. The companies are preparing to file for US approval and expect the cancer vaccine to launch in 2027, Bancel said. The intismeran/Keytruda combination is already being tested in multiple other cancers, including kidney, bladder and lung cancer. Bancel said he believes the vaccine should add to efficacy "everywhere that Keytruda works," but it remains to be seen how much it will improve results. Keytruda is approved for 19 types of cancer. The CEO also said intismeran could work on its own as a treatment in early-stage cancers. The Phase 3 melanoma results, based on patient data for the first two years after treatment, are scheduled to be presented on Saturday at the European Society for Medical Oncology meeting in Madrid. Among those who received the vaccine in addition to Keytruda, 82.2% were still cancer-free after two years, compared with 70% of patients who received Keytruda alone. "This is highly statistically significant. It is not by chance," Dr. Hussein Tawbi, a melanoma expert and trial investigator at the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center, said of the results. Several Wall Street analysts said before the meeting that investors were looking for the combination to cut the risk of recurrence by 40% or more. "We see optimism waning on pricing in multibillion-dollar (intismeran) franchises across oncology," wrote RBC analyst Trung Huynh. "This data makes us less optimistic as melanoma was supposed to be the best case." The trial tested nine doses of the vaccine along with Keytruda, beginning 13 weeks after surgery to remove melanoma lesions. The response to the combination treatment was compared with that of the patients treated with just Keytruda, a standard therapy for melanoma.

item.title: Barclays to cut 5,000 jobs in AI-led cost drive as Q3 profit rises 12%
item.description: Barclays plans to cut around 5,000 jobs, or 5% of its workforce, this year as it uses AI to reduce costs, even as third-quarter profit rose 12% to £2.3 billion.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Barclays said it is cutting around 5,000 jobs or 5 per cent of its workforce this year, as it uses technology such as artificial intelligence (AI) to slash fixed costs and improve returns. The job cuts were revealed as Barclays reported third-quarter profit of £2.3 billion ($3.08 billion), up 12 per cent from a year ago but undershooting analysts’ forecasts as its fixed income trading business underperformed. “I am disappointed, and you can be sure this will get my attention,” Chief Executive Officer C S Venkatakrishnan said about the bank’s traditional strength of fixed income trading, blaming a volatile quarter and weak trading in rates and credit products in particular. The bank said it had taken a further £201 million in “structural cost actions” in the third quarter, part of its longer-term plan to reduce expenses like staff costs through greater use of technology. Around 60 per cent of the overall job cuts will impact staff in support functions such as developers, CFO Anna Cross told reporters, in one of the clearest signs yet from a big bank of how AI is enabling firms to reduce headcount in such roles. Cross said 1,000 roles have already gone, with the remainder to be cut by the end of the year.

item.title: US regulator is probing suspicious Iran oil trading, official says
item.description: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission is probing suspicious oil trading activity around the US war in Iran and scrutinizing prediction market trading around elections, the agency's enforcement director said on Thursday at a conference in New York.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission is probing suspicious oil trading activity around the US war in Iran and scrutinizing prediction market trading around elections, the agency's enforcement director said on Thursday at a conference in New York. CFTC Enforcement Director David Miller made the remarks in response to a Bloomberg News story last week that said a CFTC political appointee had told market surveillance staff to retract a referral to the agency's enforcement team identifying suspicious trading around President Donald Trump's March decision to back away from strikes on Iran's power plants. When asked about the story during a panel at the conference, Miller said the agency had "from the beginning" been probing the trading and that the investigation remained open. The report fueled concerns raised by investor advocates and lawmakers over a decline in enforcement activity at the agency, which is dealing with an [USN:L6N43N0Y2 TEXT:"exodus of staff"] as it tries to oversee the growing prediction markets industry. Prediction markets allow people to bet on the outcome of various events, from US elections to sports games. Federal lawmakers are starting to scrutinize the industry, and most Americans oppose the idea of betting on government actions or elections, according to a mid-October [USN:L1N45S0TL TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos opinion poll"]. Miller also said the CFTC is watching for problematic trading in prediction markets, including on election outcomes. He declined to comment specifically on the November US midterm elections. CFTC staff "have investigated, and may have open investigations about some candidates who have placed trades on contracts that are based on their own elections," Miller said.

item.title: 米マイクロン、27年から全世界で業績連動報酬導入へ 台湾労組の圧力受け
item.description:
Wen-Yee Lee
[台北 ２２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーは２２日、２０２７会計年度...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米マイクロン、27年から全世界で業績連動報酬導入へ　台湾労組の圧力受け 1:14 配信

米マイクロンの施設。台湾・台中市で１５日撮影。REUTERS/Ann Wang

Wen-Yee Lee

[台北 ２２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーは２２日、２０２７会計年度から全世界の従業員を対象に、四半期ごとの業績連動型報酬制度を導入すると発表した。人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームで得られた利益のうち、従業員への分配をより多くするよう求める台湾の労働組合の圧力を受けた措置となる。

マイクロンは、新たな制度は既存の年次インセンティブ制度を補完するものだと説明。韓国の競合サムスン電子やＳＫハイニックスの制度と異なり、マイクロンは利益の配分比率や従業員向けに確保された総額については開示していない。

マイクロンによると、四半期ごとの賞与原資は、２６会計年度を基準年として、税引き後利益から次四半期の予想設備投資額を差し引いた額を基に算出する。賞与の半分は決算発表後に現金で支給され、残りは１年後に権利が確定する株式で支払われる。

ただ、新しい生産能力が収益を生み出し始める前に工場や設備に多額の投資を行うため、この方式では基礎的な業績が改善しても、生産能力拡大の局面では支給額が制限される可能性がある。

今回の発表は、２１日にマイクロンの大規模な台中事業所の労組との間で成立した合意を受けたものとなる。桃園の別の労組との協議は、２２日時点で合意に至っていない。

item.title: FIFA opens bidding for 2030 and 2034 World Cup media rights covering US and Puerto Rico
item.description: FIFA opened the bidding process for US media rights to the 2030 World Cup on Thursday along with an option to secure the 2034 edition, adding that it has yet to decide whether to keep the controversial hydration breaks introduced this year that opened up additional advertising windows for broadcasters.
item.dc:creator: Frank Pingue
item.content:encoded: FIFA opened the bidding process for US media rights to the 2030 World Cup on Thursday along with an option to secure the 2034 edition, adding that it has yet to decide whether to keep the controversial hydration breaks introduced this year that opened up additional advertising windows for broadcasters. FIFA said in a press release that it was open to "innovative approaches" to reach large audiences and that the bid submission deadline is November 19. Fox held the exclusive English-language FIFA broadcast rights in the United States for the last three World Cups, including the 2026 edition that was co-hosted by the US, Canada and Mexico, while Telemundo held the Spanish language rights during that same time. Spain, which won the 2026 World Cup, will co-host the 2030 edition with Portugal and Morocco, although Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay will also stage matches to mark the tournament's 100th anniversary. Saudi Arabia will host the 2034 World Cup. FIFA Chief Business Officer Romy Gai, speaking to reporters after the announcement, said world soccer's governing body is still evaluating whether to keep the hydration breaks that were put in place for the 2026 World Cup to help players cope with high temperatures but also proved lucrative for broadcasters. The hydration breaks fuelled debate over their impact on the game, with some viewers complaining about being exposed to commercials during the three-minute stoppages in each half. "If the average temperature will be higher than the normal average is in these countries we expect to confirm having the hydration break, but not automatically," said Gai. "It's not the final decision because this is something that we need to further engage with all the stakeholders." According to FIFA, the 2026 World Cup averaged 13.5 million viewers per match on linear and streaming platforms in the United States, up 166% on the 2022 World Cup in Qatar. Earlier this week, [USN:L6N45Z0QE TEXT:"Netflix"] announced that it secured the rights to broadcast the 2030 World Cup in Spain and Andorra. The Saudi climate will likely force FIFA to hold the 2034 tournament in the Northern Hemisphere winter, just like it did for the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, but Gai said that while it is a possibility the matter has not yet been discussed officially. "It's too early for that. But this is something that we are concretely considering," Gai said when asked about staging the 2034 World Cup in November-December of that year instead of the tournament's traditional June-July slot. "It will be further assessed and we will share the same comments with any bidders when it will be the time to sit down and analyze how it can be to play the World Cup in 2034. It is a clear possibility ... but it's not yet confirmed. So we need to understand more."

item.description: ［イスタンブール ２２日 ロイター］ - トルコ中央銀行は２２日の金融政策決定会合で、主要政策金利を１００ベーシスポイ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
トルコ中銀、利下げ再開　政策金利36％ 1:05 配信

２０２４年２月撮影　REUTERS/Cagla Gurdogan

［イスタンブール　２２日　ロイター］ - トルコ中央銀行は２２日の金融政策決定会合で、主要政策金利を１００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き下げ、３６．０％にすると決定した。市場予想とほぼ一致した。２月末に始まった米イラン交戦がインフレに与える影響を見極めるため５会合連続で金利を据え置いていた。エネルギー価格は大幅に上昇しているものの、輸入依存型のトルコ経済への影響が懸念されたほどではないとの見方から利下げに踏み切ったもようだ。

ロイターがまとめた調査で、２２人のエコノミストが利下げを予想。据え置き予想は２人だった。今年１２月の会合でさらに１００ｂｐの利下げが見込まれている。金融緩和局面は２０２７年に入っても続き、政策金利は２７年３月末に３３％、６月末に３１％、９月末に３０％、１２月末には２８％まで低下していくと見られている。

トルコの２６年９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前月比１．８４％上昇と市場予想を下回った。前年同月比では２９．７３％上昇した。ロイター調査で、２６年末時点のインフレ率予想は２９．５％。２７年末には２３．７％まで鈍化すると見込まれている。２６年の経済成長率は２．７％、２７年は３．７％に加速すると予想されている。政府は２６年の成長率見通しを３．３％、２７年は４．２％としている。

Oct 22 : AI safety evaluators METR and Redwood Research found several new vulnerabilities in OpenAI's internal system, including an exploit agents could have used to keep hundreds of their actions from being monitored, in a pilot review earlier this year. The exercise, conducted from July 21 to August 11, gave outside researchers "a deep level of access" to OpenAI's internal infrastructure for so-called embedded evaluations, the safety nonprofits said on Thursday. METR and Redwood said they each sent one researcher, tested an arrangement giving access to OpenAI's internal code, documentation and some technical staff. Both were accompanied on site and used OpenAI-issued devices that "never left the premises". OpenAI told the safety organizations it has since patched all vulnerabilities affecting its production safeguards, although METR and Redwood said they had not verified the fixes.

AI labs, experts and the Trump administration have touted independent evaluation by outside reviewers as a way to safely advance the technology without slowing its development. However, AI companies are worried that evaluator staff working inside the companies' walls could take proprietary information to rivals, Reuters reported earlier this month. While OpenAI received a full 61-page internal report, METR and Redwood said they agreed to publish only a broad summary publicly, and gave OpenAI the right to redact sensitive information. Unlike in some previous evaluations, they could not independently disclose those redactions, but said they expected greater transparency in future evaluations. The researchers also identified a potential way for OpenAI's Codex agents to bypass security restrictions and act with their users' full permissions. The evaluators assessed the monitoring system as it existed on and before July 21, and noted that OpenAI was expanding the system during the exercise. OpenAI said the "findings helped strengthen safeguards as we expanded the system and will help shape future research collaborations with METR and other third-party evaluators."

Source: Reuters

item.title: メタ株6.5％安、ＡＩ投資負担を懸念 ＣＤＳも過去最高水準
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] - ２２日午前の米株式市場で、メタ・プラットフォームズの株価が６．５％下落し、一時約６週間ぶり...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
メタ株6.5％安、ＡＩ投資負担を懸念　ＣＤＳも過去最高水準 0:36 配信

2025年6月12日、フランス・パリで撮影。 REUTERS/Benoit Tessier/File Photo

[２２日 ロイター] - ２２日午前の米株式市場で、メタ・プラットフォームズの株価が６．５％下落し、一時約６週間ぶりの安値を付けた。同社のクレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（ＣＤＳ） も過去最高水準に上昇している。投資家は、急成長する人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェント事業の恩恵と、野心的なＡＩ事業拡大に伴う資金負担の増大を見極めている。

マークイットのデータによると、同社の債務不履行に備える保証コストであるＣＤＳは、５年物スプレッドが７．６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）拡大し、過去最高の１１４．７９ｂｐとなった。１日の拡大幅としては少なくとも２０２５年以降で最大となる見通し。

２１日終値時点では、株価は２６年に入って５％超上昇していた。現在の下落幅が続けば、時価総額は約８５０億ドル減少する見通し。

メタが２１日に発表した第３・四半期決算は、売上高が６４６億ドルと、ＬＳＥＧが集計したアナリスト予想の６３３億７０００万ドルを上回った。第４・四半期の売上高見通しも市場予想を上回った。

また、２６年の設備投資見通しを１３５０億─１４５０億ドルとし、従来の１３００億─１４５０億ドルから下限を引き上げた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず 最終更新: 10/23(金) 1:12 ロイター

item.title: Terremoto de magnitude 7 atinge Tibete, na China, matando 16 pessoas, segundo Xinhua
item.description: Um terremoto de magnitude 7 atingiu a região do Tibete, no sudoeste da China, por volta das 22h33 desta quinta-feira (horário local), matando 16 pessoas e ferindo outras 32, informou a agência de notícias estatal Xinhua, citando o departamento de gestão de emergências da cidade de Nagqu.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Um terremoto de magnitude 7 atingiu a região do Tibete, no sudoeste da China, por volta das 22h33 desta quinta-feira (horário local), matando 16 pessoas e ferindo outras 32, informou a agência de notícias estatal Xinhua, citando o departamento de gestão de emergências da cidade de Nagqu. Até as 2h25 da madrugada de sexta-feira (horário local), 11 dos feridos estavam em estado grave, enquanto 21 apresentavam ferimentos leves, informou a Xinhua. Autoridades locais encontraram pelo menos duas pessoas feridas em uma vila próxima ao epicentro, e algumas casas nas vilas mais próximas do epicentro apresentavam rachaduras, informou a emissora estatal. O terremoto é o mais forte a atingir a China desde janeiro de 2024. O epicentro foi localizado em um condado pouco povoado e de alta altitude em Nagqu, no norte do Tibete, a uma profundidade de 10 km. A altitude média em um raio de 5 km do epicentro é de cerca de 4.864 metros, segundo dados do Centro de Redes Sísmicas da China (CENC). Vídeos divulgados pela mídia oficial local mostraram pessoas deixando suas casas e buscando abrigo ao ar livre ou em seus carros estacionados na rua. Um morador relatou ter sido acordado pelo forte terremoto e ouvido a casa ranger com o tremor. O terremoto foi claramente sentido na região, informou o CENC. O epicentro foi a cerca de 400 km da capital tibetana, Lhasa. Equipes locais de bombeiros e resgate foram mobilizadas e estavam a caminho da região afetada, informou a mídia estatal. Uma série de tremores menores, de magnitude 3 e 4, foram registrados nas regiões vizinhas após o terremoto de magnitude 7, mostraram os dados do CENC. Em 2010, um tremor de magnitude 7,1 atingiu Yushu, na província vizinha de Qinghai, matando pelo menos 2.698 pessoas e deixando quase 300 desaparecidas. (Reportagem de Xiuhao Chen, Yukun Zhang e Liz Lee em Pequim, e Gnaneshwar Rajan em Bengaluru)

Oct 22 : Cable production capacity is emerging as a bottleneck for AI-driven data centre construction, Nexans' finance chief said, as demand rises faster than the industry's ability to expand manufacturing capacity. Global cable capacity is tight and building a new cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) cable production line, known in the industry as a CV line, takes around three years, limiting how quickly suppliers can respond to demand, Nexans CFO Vincent Piquet told Reuters. "Things can't move quickly and the people building these data centres are in a great hurry," Piquet said. Data centres require large amounts of low- and medium-voltage cable to connect power infrastructure, with larger facilities consuming proportionately more medium-voltage cable.

The strain on power infrastructure is already delaying some projects. In September, Oracle issued a force majeure notice to a Blue Owl unit developing a large data centre in New Mexico, citing potential difficulties securing sufficient power for the site. Piquet said grid constraints, while slowing some projects, were also supporting demand for Nexans' products and allowing the company to be more selective when allocating capacity. French distribution network operator Enedis has moved from annual procurement agreements to contracts lasting six or seven years in order to secure cable supply, he said. While Europe generally faces fewer grid-connection challenges than the United States and benefits from stronger electricity networks in some northern countries, Piquet said lengthy regulatory processes were delaying certain projects. He said he did not expect demand linked to artificial intelligence to slow, although Europe's data-centre expansion was likely to be less pronounced than in the United States because private investment capacity was smaller and public funding played a larger role.

Source: Reuters

item.title: South Africa’s Trade With China Surges After Beijing’s Zero-Tariff Deal
item.description: South Africa’s trade with China has increased since Beijing introduced a temporary zero-tariff scheme for qualifying South African exports in May, offering Pretoria an opportunity to expand sales to its largest trading partner as relations with the United States come under increasing strain. South African …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
South Africa’s trade with China has increased since Beijing introduced a temporary zero-tariff scheme for qualifying South African exports in May, offering Pretoria an opportunity to expand sales to its largest trading partner as relations with the United States come under increasing strain.

South African exports to China rose nearly 25% year over year between May and August, while imports from China increased 23% over the same period, Chinese Ambassador Wu Peng said at an event in Pretoria on Thursday.

South Africa has been seeking to rebalance its trade with China, which is its largest trading partner. In 2025, South Africa exported about 222 billion rand ($13.5 billion) worth of goods to China and imported nearly twice that amount, Trade Minister Parks Tau said.

South Africa’s exports to China include agricultural products, minerals and manufactured goods. The government is seeking to expand access for higher-value products as it looks to narrow the trade imbalance and diversify its export markets.

Wu said he had heard South Africa’s concerns about the imbalance in bilateral trade and expressed confidence that Chinese market access for South African products would expand.

“I am confident more and more South African high value-added products will enter the Chinese market in the future,” he said.

China’s zero-tariff preference scheme took effect on May 1, 2026, and is scheduled to run through April 30, 2028, pending a broader economic partnership arrangement between China and African countries. The temporary measure covers qualifying South African exports that meet applicable rules of origin and documentation requirements, while certain products are subject to tariff-rate quotas.

The arrangement provides South African exporters with an opportunity to compete in the Chinese market without paying customs duties on eligible goods. However, the increase in trade recorded since May does not establish how much of the growth resulted directly from the tariff changes.

For Pretoria, expanding exports to China is part of a broader effort to develop alternative markets as uncertainty over access to the U.S. market threatens an established source of export demand.

The United States has extended the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA), which gives eligible sub-Saharan African countries duty-free access to the U.S. market for thousands of products, through 2028. South Africa, however, faces the risk of exclusion as President Donald Trump’s administration has criticized several of its domestic and foreign policies.

The Trump administration has accused the South African government of persecuting white people, an allegation Pretoria denies.

South African President Cyril Ramaphosa said on October 19 that the country must prepare for the possibility of losing its AGOA benefits, as his government pursues alternative markets and holds discussions with U.S. counterparts.

Tau said he expected an announcement in early November on whether South Africa would be excluded from the program, but remained “cautiously optimistic.”

The uncertainty has added urgency to South Africa’s efforts to diversify its export destinations, including through stronger commercial ties with China. However, expanding trade with Beijing does not necessarily guarantee a reduction in the bilateral trade imbalance, particularly as imports from China are also rising.

South Africa’s ability to benefit from the Chinese scheme will depend partly on whether domestic producers can increase exports of qualifying goods and move into higher-value agricultural, industrial and processed products. The tariff preference removes customs duties on eligible exports but does not eliminate other market-access requirements.

The two countries’ trade figures point to expanding commercial ties, but the challenge for Pretoria will be to translate that growth into greater export earnings and a more balanced trading relationship.

With a decision on South Africa’s AGOA eligibility expected in early November, the country faces pressure to strengthen its position in China and other markets while seeking to preserve preferential access to the United States.

FAST

BRUSSELS, Oct 22 : Digital advertisers and publishers lobbied on Thursday for EU and UK regulators to suspend Meta Platforms' new commercial terms due to come into effect on October 30, alleging that these would give Meta an unlimited right to use their content for its AI services. Advocacy group the Movement for an Open Web, whose members include digital advertisers and publishers, said it had complained to the European Commission and the UK's Competition and Markets Authority and requested interim measures. Publishers worldwide are stepping up their fight with AI companies that use their content without permission to train large language models, underscoring the clash between copyright owners and those citing fair use arguments. "Meta's new terms are clearly anti-competitive. Many businesses effectively have no choice but to use Meta's services and these conditions would force them to sign away the rights to their digital content with no means of opting out," Tim Cowen, co-founder of the Movement for an Open Web, said.

"The terms would give Meta a free hand to scrape content from nearly every website in the world, potentially using that data to power AI-powered services that would then compete with those businesses," he said. Meta said it disagreed with the complaint. "The crawling terms we consolidated only applied to our ads and business products, and we've clarified that in the terms themselves. It does not change how Meta uses web crawlers," a Meta spokesperson said. "As always, content owners can use robots.txt to signal their preferences. This is not about scraping news sites, and these updates don't give us new rights that supersede those preferences." The CMA said it met with Meta on Wednesday to get more details on its new business terms. "This is an important issue and we recognise the concerns that have been raised by businesses in the UK. We are engaged in urgent discussions with Meta as we consider our next steps," a CMA spokesperson said. The European Commission said it has received a complaint which it would assess in line with its usual procedure and that it was committed to ensuring that Meta's practices comply with EU laws.  Companies requesting interim measures have to show that they will suffer serious and irreparable damage from the alleged anti-competitive practices. The criticism by the Movement for an Open Web followed similar complaints aired by the European Publishers Council (EPC) last week and Germany's Digital Publishers and Newspaper Publishers Association (BDZV) and the Association of the Free Press (MVFP) earlier this week.

Source: Reuters

Oct 22 : Nippon Steel will invest about $3 billion in the U.S. Steel-operated Mon Valley works in Pennsylvania to upgrade the plant's hot rolling facility, the Nikkei newspaper reported on Thursday. The move is part of the Japanese steelmaker's pledge to invest $11 billion in U.S. Steel by 2028, following its acquisition of the company in 2025. Nippon Steel did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours. Mon Valley's hot rolling equipment, which heats slabs of iron from blast furnaces and rolls them into thinner steel, has been in operation for about 90 years, Nikkei added. The new equipment is set to enter operation in the second half of 2029, which would enable production of higher-quality steel, the report said. Nippon Steel raised its fiscal 2026 earnings forecast in August, lifted by stronger U.S. Steel earnings and a firm steel market.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 22 : Anyone who has watched a manta ray glide over a reef knows how unhurried these marine animals can look. Yet researchers working off Costa Rica found their movements are varied, with juveniles staying nearby and close to shore while adults venture hundreds of kilometres. Manta rays are among the ocean's largest fish, with wing-like fins that can span up to about 8 meters (26 feet) and the largest brain of any fish. Researchers tracked endangered oceanic manta rays between 2018 and 2025, fitting 59 of them with acoustic transmitters and tracking 12 with satellite tags, along with photo identification.  "By combining different technologies ... we were able to piece together a highly detailed map of their movements and their use of coastal cleaning stations," said Jeffry Madrigal-Mesén, director of the research group Mantas Costa Rica and lead author of the study published in the journal Frontiers in Fish Science.

A coastal cleaning station is a rocky reef site where small fish remove parasites from the skin of the manta rays in an example of symbiotic behaviour. Researchers found that smaller, immature mantas stayed within Costa Rica's coastal waters, called its exclusive economic zone. Larger, mature animals undertook long-distance journeys, some reaching as far as the waters off Guatemala. "This makes us believe that smaller mantas do not risk these long migrations, likely due to the threat of large predators like orcas and tiger sharks," Madrigal-Mesén said. The smaller animals in the study measured around 3 to 3.5 meters across (10 to 11.5 feet), compared with around 4 to 4.5 meters (13 to 15 feet) for those making the longer journeys. DANGER FROM PREDATORS A juvenile, at around 3 meters across, would still appear enormous to most swimmers. Yet that size may not be enough protection. Madrigal-Mesén said that "their massive size is one of their main defence mechanisms. It is quite common to see animals missing portions of their bodies, and in many cases, the shape of the wounds strongly suggests they are bites from other large marine predators." What prompts mantas to eventually join the migratory population remains unclear, although researchers suspect that reaching feeding and breeding grounds in highly productive waters across Central America may play a role. The manta rays also repeatedly return to the same coastal cleaning stations. Observations of feeding, courtship and recent mating suggest these sites may also function as social hubs. Scientists do not yet know how mantas navigate back to particular sites. "Based on the bathymetry of the different sites we monitor, there must be a relationship with the rock formations. We humans have favourite places we like to go to," Madrigal-Mesén said. "Why couldn't mantas have a preference for one cleaning station over another?" The findings also suggest the mantas may not roam as far as once thought. Researchers initially suspected that animals seen in Costa Rica might migrate from populations in Ecuador or Mexico. The tracking data instead raises the possibility that Central America has its own distinct population, something the team is now investigating through genetic work. Mantas are particularly vulnerable because, like other rays and sharks, they reproduce slowly and take years to reach sexual maturity. Madrigal-Mesén said that once the animals left Cocos Island, a volcanic island in the Pacific Ocean, and most monitored coastal sites, they entered waters with no protection, exposing them to threats including fishing and vessel traffic. "Studies like this help us recognise that these coastal havens only protect them for a specific time of the year. ... This is why it is so critical to protect the marine corridors these migratory species travel through." Coastal mantas also showed strong site fidelity, with very few moving between monitoring sites even when they were only tens of kilometres apart.  One male became a particularly striking example. Nicknamed "Mickey Mouse" for its distinctive spot pattern, the ray was repeatedly photographed at Cabo Blanco and tracked using both satellite and acoustic tags, showing a strong attachment to the site.  But researchers have not seen this ray in Costa Rica for more than a year.  "We have a lot of affection for him," Madrigal-Mesén added. "We hope he comes back soon."

Source: Reuters

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 22 : The yen was on track for its strongest daily gain in almost a month on Thursday, as investors sought safety amid fragile equity markets, elevated crude prices from the drawn-out war in the Middle East, and doubts over future returns from artificial intelligence. The US dollar, meanwhile, rose against the euro. Worries about social unrest in France and a worsening fiscal outlook for the country outweighed concerns about the AI trade, which pushed US stocks lower. "AI is making people nervous, as is oil ... and as is France," said Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets. Oil prices climbed about 3 per cent to a five-month high after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concerns of further disruption to energy supplies from the key exporting region.

The Japanese yen strengthened 0.75 per cent to 156.96 per dollar. Some of the move in the yen may also be due to its approaching the key 160 level, which is seen as increasing the odds of further intervention by Japanese authorities to shore up the currency. Kevin Ford, lead FX and macro strategist at Convera, called it "the intervention premium," noting that "every time the yen gets closer to the 160 line, that's where there's higher speculation that the central bank will intervene." Against the Swiss franc, another traditional safe haven, the dollar weakened 0.42 per cent to  0.821 francs per dollar. The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, fell 0.08 per cent to 101.60, with the euro down 0.09 per cent at $1.1222. The dollar has become increasingly tied to capital flows and to growth and inflation expectations linked to the AI trade. It fell last week as fears over the AI outlook grew. On Thursday, however, concerns about France outweighed those fears. "You have these competing stories and weak points between US AI-related credits and then France's sovereign credit, and we've seen this push and pull in the last couple of days where at times one is more of a concern than the other,” said Erik Nelson, global head of FX strategy at Wells Fargo. “As long as France is more of a concern than US AI credits, then you're going to see the euro underperform.” French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that "illegitimate" protests would be banned in the coming days and blamed "seditious" ultra-left groups and vandals for last weekend's riots and looting. Concerns about France's ability to manage its huge debt burden have hurt French government bonds and raised worries about other heavily indebted euro zone countries. The spread between France and Germany's 10-year note yields reached 177.7 basis points on Thursday, the widest gap since 2011. Sterling strengthened 0.05 per cent to $1.3401. The Australian dollar  weakened 0.11 per cent to $0.7019. In cryptocurrencies, bitcoin fell 4.27 per cent to $81,023.  (Additional reporting by Amanda Cooper and Tom Westbrook; Editing by Xevi Fontdegloria and Andrea Ricci )

Source: Reuters
